Newton’s theory of gravitation and some of its limitations are part of current background knowledge, whereas a temperature dependence of gravitational attraction is not. Here is one further example in support of the historical perspective that the falsificationists introduce into confirmation. Hertz confirmed Maxwell’s theory when he detected the first radio waves. I also confirm Maxwell’s theory whenever I listen to my radio. The logical situation is similar in the two cases. In each case, the theory predicts that radio waves should be detected and, in each case, their successful detection lends some inductive support to the theory. Nevertheless, Hertz is justly famous for the confirmation he achieved, whereas my frequent confirmations are rightly ignored in a scientific context. Hertz made a significant step forward. When I listen to my radio I am only marking time. The historical context makes all the difference.

证伪主义相对于归纳主义的优势

Advantages of falsificationism over inductivism

在总结了证伪主义的基本特征之后，现在是时候考察一下与归纳主义立场相比，证伪主义立场有哪些优势了。归纳主义立场认为，科学知识是从给定的事实中归纳出来的，我们在前面的章节中讨论过归纳主义立场。

With a summary of the basic features of falsificationism behind us, it is time to survey some of the advantages that this position can be said to have over the inductivist position, according to which scientific knowledge is inductively derived from given facts, which we discussed in earlier chapters.

我们已经看到，某些事实，尤其是实验结果，在某种重要意义上依赖于理论且易出错。这削弱了那些要求科学拥有毋庸置疑的既定事实基础的归纳主义者的论点。证伪主义者承认事实和理论一样都可能出错。然而，对于证伪主义者而言，存在着一套重要的事实，构成了科学理论的检验场。这套事实由那些经受住了严格检验的事实主张组成。这确实意味着科学的事实基础是易出错的，但这对于证伪主义者而言并不像对归纳主义者那样构成重大问题，因为证伪主义者追求的只是科学的持续改进，而非对真理或可能真理的证明。

We have seen that some facts, and especially experimental results, are in an important sense theory-dependent and fallible. This undermines those inductivists who require science to have an unproblematic and given factual foundation. The falsificationist recognises that facts as well as theories are fallible. Nevertheless, for the falsificationist there is an important set of facts that constitutes the testing ground for scientific theories. It consists of those factual claims that have survived severe tests. This does have the consequence that the factual basis for science is fallible, but this does not pose as big a problem for falsificationists as it does for inductivists, since the falsificationist seeks only constant improvement in science rather than demonstrations of truth or probable truth.

归纳主义者难以明确定义良好归纳推理的标准，因此也难以回答关于事实在何种情况下能够为理论提供显著支持的问题。证伪主义者在这方面则表现得更好。当事实构成对理论的严格检验时，它们就能为理论提供显著支持。对新预测的证实正是此类事实的重要组成部分。这有助于解释为什么重复实验并不会显著增加对理论的经验支持——极端归纳主义者难以接受这一事实。进行特定实验本身或许能够构成对理论的严格检验。然而，如果实验执行得当，且理论经受住了检验，那么后续重复同一实验将不再被视为对理论的严格检验，因此其对理论的显著支持作用也会越来越弱。此外，归纳主义者难以解释如何从可观察的事实中推导出对不可观察事物的认识，而证伪主义者则不存在这样的问题。通过探索其新颖的后果，可以对关于不可观察事物的论断进行严格检验，从而得到支持。

The inductivist had trouble specifying the criteria for a good inductive inference, and so had difficulty answering questions concerning the circumstances under which facts can be said to give significant support to theories. The falsificationist fares better in this respect. Facts give significant support to theories when they constitute severe tests of that theory. The confirmations of novel predictions are important members of this category. This helps to explain why repetition of experiments does not result in a significant increase in the empirical support for a theory, a fact that the extreme inductivist has difficulty accommodating. The conduct of a particular experiment might well constitute a severe test of a theory. However, if the experiment has been adequately performed and the theory has survived the test, then subsequent repetitions of that same experiment will not be considered as severe a test of the theory, and so will become increasingly less able to offer significant support for it. Again, whereas the inductivist has problems explaining how knowledge of the unobservable can ever be derived from observable facts, the falsificationist has no such problem. Claims about the unobservable can be severely tested, and hence supported, by exploring their novel consequences.

我们已经看到，归纳主义者难以描述和论证那些旨在证明理论为真或可能为真的归纳推理。证伪主义者声称，他们通过坚持科学不涉及归纳来规避这些问题。演绎法被用来揭示理论的推论，以便对其进行检验，并最终证伪。但证伪主义者并不声称，经受住检验就表明某个理论为真或可能为真。充其量，此类检验的结果只能表明该理论比之前的理论有所改进。证伪主义者满足于进步，而非真理。

We have seen that inductivists have trouble characterising and justifying the inductive inferences that are meant to show theories to be true or probably true. The falsificationist claims to bypass these problems by insisting that science does not involve induction. Deduction is used to reveal the consequences of theories so that they can be tested, and perhaps falsified. But no claims are made to the effect that the survival of tests shows a theory to be true or probably true. At best, the results of such tests show a theory to be an improvement on its predecessor. The falsificationist settles for progress rather than truth.

延伸阅读

Further reading

关于波普尔对其证伪主义的成熟思考，可参阅他1983年出版的《实在论与科学的目标》。希尔普（Schilpp，1974）在“当代哲学家文库”系列中收录了波普尔的自传、一些批评家对其哲学的评论文章、波普尔对这些批评家的回应，以及一份详尽的波普尔著作目录。阿克曼（Ackermann，1976）和奥赫尔（O'Hear，1980）对波普尔的观点进行了简明扼要的概述。查尔默斯（Chalmers，1973）对“证伪主义科学论证中的证实”一节中涉及的波普尔观点修正进行了更详细的讨论。

For Popper’s mature reflections on his falsificationism see his 1983 text, Realism and the Aim of Science. Schilpp (1974), in the Library of Living Philosophers series, contains Popper’s autobiography, a number of articles on his philosophy by critics, and Popper’s reply to those critics, as well as a detailed bibliography of Popper’s writings. Accessible overviews of Popper’s views are Ackermann (1976) and O’Hear (1980). The modification of Popper’s views involved in the section ‘Confirmation in the falsificationist account of science’ is discussed in more detail in Chalmers (1973).

第七章

CHAPTER 7

证伪主义的局限性

The limitations of falsificationism

逻辑情境引发的问题

Problems stemming from the logical situation

构成科学定律的概括性结论永远无法从有限的可观察事实中逻辑推导出来，而一条定律的谬误却可以从与其相悖的单个可观察事实中逻辑推导出来。例如，通过观察发现只有一只黑天鹅，就证伪了“所有天鹅都是白色的”这一定律。这是一个显而易见且无可辩驳的事实。然而，以此作为支持证伪主义科学哲学的依据，并非像表面看起来那么简单。一旦我们从极其简单的例子（例如天鹅的颜色）转向更接近科学实践中常见情况的复杂案例，问题就会立刻出现。

The generalisations that constitute scientific laws can never be logically deduced from a finite set of observable facts, whereas the falsity of a law can be logically deduced from a single observable fact with which it clashes. Establishing by observation that there is just one black swan falsifies ‘all swans are white’. This is an unexceptional and undeniable point. However, using it as grounds to support a falsificationist philosophy of science is not as straightforward as it might seem. Problems emerge as soon as we progress beyond extremely simple examples, such as the one concerning the colour of swans, to more complicated cases that are closer to the kind of situation typically met with in science.

如果某个观察陈述 O 为真，那么逻辑上可以推导出某个理论 T 为假，因为该理论 T 蕴含 O 为假。然而，正是证伪主义者坚持认为，构成科学基础的观察陈述依赖于理论且易出错。因此，T 与 O 之间的冲突并不意味着 T 为假。T 蕴含与 O 不一致的预测这一事实，其逻辑推论仅仅是 T 或 O 为假，但仅凭逻辑无法判断哪一个为假。当观察和实验提供的证据与某些定律或理论的预测相冲突时，问题可能出在证据本身，而非定律或理论。逻辑上并没有任何规定要求在与观察或实验相冲突时，必须总是否定定律或理论。一个易出错的观察陈述可以被否定，而与之冲突的易出错的理论则可以被保留。这正是哥白尼理论被保留而肉眼观测到的金星和火星大小（与该理论逻辑不符）被弃置一事的原因所在。同样，现代月球运行轨迹的精确数据被保留而基于肉眼观测的月球大小估算值被否定，也存在类似的情况。无论一项事实性论断多么基于可靠的观测或实验，证伪主义者的立场都使得他们无法排除科学知识的进步可能会揭示该论断的不足之处。因此，通过观测直接、确凿地证伪理论是不可能的。

If the truth of some observation statement, O, is given, then the falsity of a theory T which logically entails that O is not the case can be deduced. However, it is the falsificationists themselves who insist that the observation statements that constitute the basis of science are theory-dependent and fallible. Consequently, a clash between T and O does not have the consequence that T is false. All that logically follows from the fact that T entails a prediction inconsistent with O is that either T or O is false, but logic alone cannot tell us which. When observation and experiment provide evidence that conflicts with the predictions of some law or theory, it may be the evidence that is at fault rather than the law or theory. Nothing in the logic of the situation requires that it is always the law or theory that should be rejected on the occasion of a clash with observation or experiment. A fallible observation statement might be rejected and the fallible theory with which it clashes retained. This is precisely what was involved when Copernicus’s theory was retained and the naked-eye observations of the sizes of Venus and Mars, which were logically inconsistent with that theory, discarded. It is also what is involved when modern specifications of the moon’s trajectory are retained and estimates of its size based on unaided observation rejected. However securely based on observation or experiment a factual claim might be, the falsificationist’s position makes it impossible to rule out the possibility that advances in scientific knowledge might reveal inadequacies in that claim. Consequently, straightforward, conclusive falsifications of theories by observation are not achievable.

证伪的逻辑难题远不止于此。“所有天鹅都是白色的”这一命题，如果能找到一只非白色的天鹅，显然就被证伪了。然而，像这样对证伪逻辑的简化说明，掩盖了证伪主义面临的一个严重难题，即任何现实检验情境的复杂性。一个现实的科学理论并非像“所有天鹅都是白色的”那样的单一命题，而是由一系列普遍性陈述构成。此外，如果要对一个理论进行实验检验，那么需要考虑的因素远不止构成该理论本身的那些陈述。该理论需要补充一些辅助假设，例如，关于所用仪器的定律和理论。另外，为了推导出一些需要通过实验检验的预测，还需要添加一些初始条件，例如对实验装置的描述。例如，假设要通过望远镜观测某个行星的位置来检验一个天文理论。该理论必须预测在特定时间观测到行星所需的望远镜方位。推导出预测的前提包括构成待检验理论的相互关联的陈述、初始条件（例如行星和太阳的先前位置）、辅助假设（例如用于修正行星光线在地球大气层中折射的假设）等等。现在，如果从这一系列前提推导出的预测最终被证明是错误的（在我们的例子中，如果行星没有出现在预测的位置），那么根据逻辑，我们只能得出至少一个前提是错误的结论。但这并不能帮助我们确定是哪个前提出了问题。问题可能出在待检验的理论本身，但也可能是某个辅助假设或对初始条件的描述中的某些部分导致了错误的预测。一个理论无法被彻底证伪，因为不能排除复杂测试情境中除被测理论之外的其他因素导致了错误预测的可能性。这种难题通常被称为杜亨/奎因论题，以最早提出该论题的皮埃尔·杜亨（1962，第183-188页）和重新提出该论题的威廉·V·O·奎因（1961）的名字命名。

The logical problems for falsification do not end here. ‘All swans are white’ is certainly falsified if an instance of a non-white swan can be established. But simplified illustrations of the logic of a falsification such as this disguise a serious difficulty for falsificationism that arises from the complexity of any realistic test situation. A realistic scientific theory will consist of a complex of universal statements rather than a single statement like ‘All swans are white’. Further, if a theory is to be experimentally tested, then more will be involved than those statements that constitute the theory under test. The theory will need to be augmented by auxiliary assumptions, such as laws and theories governing the use of any instruments used, for instance. In addition, in order to deduce some prediction the validity of which is to be experimentally tested, it will be necessary to add initial conditions such as a description of the experimental set-up. For instance, suppose an astronomical theory is to be tested by observing the position of some planet through a telescope. The theory must predict the orientation of the telescope necessary for a sighting of the planet at some specified time. The premises from which the prediction is derived will include the interconnected statements that constitute the theory under test, initial conditions such as previous positions of the planet and sun, auxiliary assumptions such as those enabling corrections to be made for refraction of light from the planet in the earth’s atmosphere, and so on. Now if the prediction that follows from this maze of premises turns out to be false (in our example, if the planet does not appear at the predicted location), then all that the logic of the situation permits us to conclude is that at least one of the premises must be false. It does not enable us to identify the faulty premise. It may be the theory under test that is at fault, but alternatively it may be an auxiliary assumption or some part of the description of the initial conditions that is responsible for the incorrect prediction. A theory cannot be conclusively falsified, because the possibility cannot be ruled out that some part of the complex test situation, other than the theory under test, is responsible for an erroneous prediction. This difficulty often goes under the name of the Duhem/Quine thesis, after Pierre Duhem (1962, pp. 183–8) who first raised it and William V.O. Quine (1961) who revived it.

以下是一些天文学史上的例子，可以说明这一点。

Here are some examples from the history of astronomy that illustrate the point.

在之前举过的一个例子中，我们讨论了牛顿的理论是如何被天王星的轨道所推翻的。但实际上，问题不在于理论本身，而在于对初始条件的描述，因为其中没有考虑到当时尚未发现的海王星。第二个例子是丹麦天文学家第谷·布拉赫在哥白尼理论首次发表几十年后，声称自己通过论证推翻了该理论。布拉赫认为，如果地球绕太阳公转，那么随着地球在一年中从太阳的一侧移动到另一侧，从地球上观测到的恒星方向应该会发生变化。但是，当布拉赫试图用当时最精确、最灵敏的仪器来探测这种预测的视差时，却失败了。这使得布拉赫得出结论：哥白尼的理论是错误的。事后看来，导致预测错误的并非哥白尼的理论，而是布拉赫的一个辅助假设。布拉赫对恒星距离的估计远低于实际值。当他的估计被更合理的估计所取代时，预测的视差就变得太小，以至于布拉赫的仪器无法探测到。

In an example used previously, we discussed how Newton’s theory was apparently refuted by the orbit of the planet Uranus. In this case, it turned out not to be the theory that was at fault but the description of the initial conditions, which did not include a consideration of the yet-to-be-discovered planet Neptune. A second example involves an argument by means of which the Danish astronomer Tycho Brahé claimed to have refuted the Copernican theory a few decades after its first publication. If the earth orbits the sun, Brahé argued, then the direction in which a fixed star is observed from earth should vary during the course of the year as the earth moves from one side of the sun to the other. But when Brahé tried to detect this predicted parallax with his instruments, which were the most accurate and sensitive ones in existence at the time, he failed. This led Brahé to conclude that the Copernican theory was false. With hindsight, it can be appreciated that it was not the Copernican theory that was responsible for the faulty prediction, but one of Brahé’s auxiliary assumptions. Brahé’s estimate of the distance of the fixed stars was many times too small. When his estimate is replaced by a more realistic one, the predicted parallax turns out to be too small to be detectable by Brahé’s instruments.

第三个例子是伊姆雷·拉卡托斯（Imre Lakatos，1970，第100-101页）提出的一个假设性例子。内容如下：

A third example is a hypothetical one devised by Imre Lakatos (1970, pp. 100–1). It reads as follows:

这个故事讲述的是一个虚构的行星异常运行案例。一位爱因斯坦之前的物理学家运用牛顿力学及其万有引力定律（记为N），以及公认的初始条件（记为I），计算出一颗新发现的小行星p的运行轨迹。然而，这颗行星的运行轨迹偏离了计算结果。这位牛顿物理学家会认为这种偏差违反了牛顿的理论，因此一旦证实，就推翻了牛顿的理论（记为N）吗？不会。他提出，必定存在一颗此前未知的行星p₁ ，它扰乱了p的运行轨迹。他计算了这颗假想行星的质量、轨道等参数，然后请一位实验天文学家来验证他的假设。行星p₁非常小，即使是当时最大的望远镜也无法观测到它；于是，这位实验天文学家申请了一笔研究经费，建造了一台更大的望远镜。三年后，新的望远镜建成。如果未知行星p 1被发现，那将被视为牛顿科学的又一次胜利。但事实并非如此。我们的科学家会放弃牛顿的理论以及扰动行星的概念吗？不会。他提出，一团宇宙尘埃云遮蔽了这颗行星。他计算了这团尘埃云的位置和性质，并申请研究经费发射一颗卫星来验证他的计算结果。如果这颗卫星上的仪器（可能是基于一个未经充分验证的理论而研制的新型仪器）能够记录到这团假定的尘埃云的存在，那将被视为牛顿科学的一次重大胜利。但尘埃云并未被发现。我们的科学家会放弃牛顿的理论，以及扰动行星和遮蔽行星的尘埃云的概念吗？不会。他提出，宇宙的那个区域存在某种磁场，干扰了卫星仪器的探测。一颗新的卫星被发射升空。如果磁场被发现，牛顿主义者将会庆祝一场轰动性的胜利。但事实并非如此。这是否被视为对牛顿科学的反驳？不。要么有人提出了另一个巧妙的辅助假设，要么……整个故事就此尘封在期刊的尘封卷宗中，再也没有人提起过。

The story is about an imaginary case of planetary misbehaviour. A physicist of the pre-Einsteinian era takes Newton’s mechanics and his law of gravitation, N, the accepted initial conditions, I, and calculates, with their help, the path of a newly discovered small planet, p. But the planet deviates from the calculated path. Does our Newtonian physicist consider that the deviation was forbidden by Newton’s theory and therefore that, once established, it refutes the theory N? No. He suggests that there must be a hitherto unknown planet p1, which perturbs the path of p. He calculates the mass, orbit, etc. of this hypothetical planet and then asks an experimental astronomer to test his hypothesis. The planet p1 is so small that even the biggest available telescopes cannot possibly observe it; the experimental astronomer applies for a research grant to build yet a bigger one. In three years time, the new telescope is ready. Were the unknown planet p1 to be discovered, it would be hailed as a new victory of Newtonian science. But it is not. Does our scientist abandon Newton’s theory and his idea of the perturbing planet? No. He suggests that a cloud of cosmic dust hides the planet from us. He calculates the location and properties of this cloud and asks for a research grant to send up a satellite to test his calculations. Were the satellite’s instruments (possibly new ones, based on a little-tested theory) to record the existence of the conjectural cloud, the result would be hailed as an outstanding victory for Newtonian science. But the cloud is not found. Does our scientist abandon Newton’s theory, together with the idea of the perturbing planet and the idea of the cloud which hides it? No. He suggests that there is some magnetic field in that region of the universe which disturbed the instruments of the satellite. A new satellite is sent up. Were the magnetic field to be found, Newtonians would celebrate a sensational victory. But it is not. Is this regarded as a refutation of Newtonian science? No. Either yet another ingenious auxiliary hypothesis is proposed or . . . the whole story is buried in the dusty volumes of periodicals and the story never mentioned again.

如果这个故事被认为是合理的，它说明了如何通过将证伪转移到复杂的假设网络中的其他部分来保护理论免受证伪。

If this story is regarded as a plausible one, it illustrates how a theory can always be protected from falsification by deflecting the falsification to some other part of the complex web of assumptions.

从历史角度来看，证伪主义是不充分的

Falsificationism inadequate on historical grounds

对证伪主义者而言，一个令人尴尬的历史事实是：如果科学家们严格遵循他们的方法论，那么那些被普遍认为是科学理论典范的理论根本就不会出现，因为它们会在萌芽阶段就被否定。任何经典的科学理论，无论是在其最初提出之时还是之后，都可能存在一些当时被普遍接受的、但被认为与该理论相悖的观察结果。然而，这些理论最终并未被否定，这对科学而言实属幸运。以下是一些支持我观点的历史例证。

An embarrassing historical fact for falsificationists is that if their methodology had been strictly adhered to by scientists then those theories generally regarded as being among the best examples of scientific theories would never have been developed because they would have been rejected in their infancy. Given any example of a classic scientific theory, whether at the time of its first proposal or at a later date, it is possible to find observational claims that were generally accepted at the time and were considered to be inconsistent with the theory. Nevertheless, those theories were not rejected, and it is fortunate for science that they were not. Some historical examples to support my claim follow.

在牛顿万有引力理论诞生的早期，月球轨道观测结果就曾证伪过它。人们花了近五十年时间才将这一证伪归因于其他原因，而非牛顿理论本身。后来，人们发现该理论与水星轨道的细节不符，但科学家们并未因此放弃牛顿理论。最终，人们发现，无论如何解释这一证伪，都无法维护牛顿理论的权威性。

In the early years of its life, Newton’s gravitational theory was falsified by observations of the moon’s orbit. It took almost fifty years to deflect this falsification on to causes other than Newton’s theory. Later in its life, the same theory was known to be inconsistent with the details of the orbit of the planet Mercury, although scientists did not abandon the theory for that reason. It turned out that it was never possible to explain away this falsification in a way that protected Newton’s theory.

第二个例子与玻尔的原子理论有关，出自拉卡托斯（Lakatos，1970，第140-154页）。该理论的早期版本与某些物质能够稳定存在超过约10⁻⁸秒的观测结果相矛盾。根据该理论，原子内的带负电电子围绕带正电的原子核运行。但根据玻尔理论所预设的经典电磁理论，绕原子核运行的电子应该会辐射能量。这种辐射会导致绕原子核运行的电子失去能量并坍缩到原子核中。经典电磁学的定量分析表明，这种坍缩过程大约需要10⁻⁸秒。幸运的是，尽管存在这一谬误，玻尔仍然坚持他的理论。

A second example concerns Bohr’s theory of the atom, and is due to Lakatos (1970, pp. 140–54). Early versions of the theory were inconsistent with the observation that some matter is stable for a time that exceeds about 10–8 seconds. According to the theory, negatively charged electrons within atoms orbit around positively charged nuclei. But according to the classical electromagnetic theory presupposed by Bohr’s theory, orbiting electrons should radiate. The radiation would result in an orbiting electron losing energy and collapsing into the nucleus. The quantitative details of classical electromagnetism yield an estimated time of about 10–8 seconds for this collapse to occur. Fortunately, Bohr persevered with his theory, in spite of this falsification.

第三个例子与气体动力学理论有关，其优势在于该理论的创始人明确承认了其诞生之初就被证伪。1859年，麦克斯韦（1965，第1卷，第409页）发表了气体动力学理论统计版本的初步细节，并在同一篇论文中承认，该理论已被气体比热容的测量结果证伪。18年后，麦克斯韦（1877）在评论气体动力学理论的后果时写道：

A third example concerns the kinetic theory and has the advantage that the falsification of that theory at birth was explicitly acknowledged by its originator. When Maxwell (1965, vol. 1, p. 409) published the first details of a statistical version of the kinetic theory of gases in 1859, in that very same paper he acknowledged the fact that the theory was falsified by measurements on the specific heats of gases. Eighteen years later, commenting on the consequences of the kinetic theory, Maxwell (1877) wrote:

毫无疑问，其中一些观点对于我们目前关于身体构成的看法来说非常令人满意，但另一些观点可能会让我们从自满中惊醒，并最终可能使我们从迄今为止我们赖以生存的所有假设中解脱出来，回到那种彻底自觉的无知状态，而这种无知状态是知识真正进步的序曲。

Some of these, no doubt, are very satisfactory to us in our present state of opinion about the constitution of bodies, but there are others which are likely to startle us out of our complacency and perhaps ultimately to drive us out of all the hypotheses in which we have hitherto found refuge into that thoroughly conscious ignorance which is a prelude to every real advance in knowledge.

动力学理论的所有重要发展都发生在这次证伪之后。值得庆幸的是，面对气体比热测量的证伪，该理论并没有被放弃，否则那些天真的证伪主义者就会被迫坚持这样做。

All the important developments within the kinetic theory took place after this falsification. Once again, it is fortunate that the theory was not abandoned in the face of falsifications by measurements of the specific heats of gases, as the naive falsificationist would be forced to insist.

第四个例子，即哥白尼革命，将在下一节中详细阐述。这个例子强调了当考虑到重大理论变革的复杂性时，证伪主义者所面临的困境。此外，这个例子也为讨论一些更近期、更充分的、旨在阐明科学本质及其方法的尝试奠定了基础。

A fourth example, the Copernican Revolution, will be outlined in more detail in the following section. This example emphasises the difficulties that arise for the falsificationist when the complexities of major theory changes are taken into account. The example also sets the scene for a discussion of some more recent and more adequate attempts to characterise the essence of science and its methods.

哥白尼革命

The Copernican Revolution

中世纪欧洲普遍认为地球位于有限宇宙的中心，太阳、行星和恒星都围绕地球运行。支撑这一天文学理论框架的物理学和宇宙学，基本上是公元前四世纪亚里士多德发展起来的。公元二世纪，托勒密设计了一套详细的天文体系，明确了月球、太阳和所有行星的运行轨道。

It was generally accepted in medieval Europe that the earth lies at the centre of a finite universe and that the sun, planets and stars orbit around it. The physics and cosmology that provided the framework in which this astronomy was set was basically that developed by Aristotle in the fourth century bc. In the second century ad, Ptolemy devised a detailed astronomical system that specified the orbits of the moon, the sun and all the planets.

十六世纪初，哥白尼提出了一种新的天文学理论，认为地球是运动的，这挑战了亚里士多德和托勒密的体系。根据哥白尼的观点，地球并非静止于宇宙中心，而是与行星一起绕太阳运行。当哥白尼的理论被证实时，亚里士多德的世界观已被牛顿的世界观所取代。这一重大理论变革历时一个半世纪，其细节并不支持归纳主义者和证伪主义者所倡导的方法论，这表明我们需要一种不同的、或许结构更为复杂的科学及其发展历程的解释。

In the early decades of the sixteenth century, Copernicus devised a new astronomy, an astronomy involving a moving earth, which challenged the Aristotelian and Ptolemaic systems. According to the Copernican view, the earth is not stationary at the centre of the universe but orbits the sun along with the planets. By the time Copernicus’s idea had been substantiated, the Aristotelian world view had been replaced by the Newtonian one. The details of the story of this major theory change, a change that took place over one and a half centuries, do not lend support to the methodologies advocated by the inductivists and falsificationists, and indicate a need for a different, perhaps more complexly structured, account of science and its growth.

1543年，哥白尼首次发表其新天文学理论时，便出现了许多反对意见，而且这些反对意见也确实被提出。就当时的科学认知而言，这些反对意见不无道理，哥白尼也无法令人信服地反驳这些论点。为了理解这种情况，有必要了解一些亚里士多德世界观的方面，因为反对哥白尼的论点正是基于这些方面。以下将简要概述其中的一些要点。

When Copernicus first published the details of his new astronomy, in 1543, there were many arguments that could be, and were, levelled against it. Relative to the scientific knowledge of the time, these arguments were sound ones and Copernicus could not satisfactorily defend his theory against them. In order to appreciate this situation, it is necessary to be familiar with some aspects of the Aristotelian world view on which the arguments against Copernicus were based. A very brief sketch of some of the relevant points follows.

亚里士多德的宇宙被划分为两个截然不同的区域。月下区域是内部区域，从地球中心延伸到月球轨道内侧。月上区域是有限宇宙的其余部分，从月球轨道延伸到恒星球，恒星球标志着宇宙的外边界。在外层恒星球之外不存在任何东西，甚至连空间也不存在。在亚里士多德的体系中，不存在未被填充的空间。月上区域的所有天体都由一种称为以太的不可腐朽元素构成。以太具有围绕宇宙中心做完美圆周运动的天然倾向。托勒密的天文学对这一基本思想进行了修正和扩展。由于不同时期对行星位置的观测无法与以地球为中心的圆形轨道相吻合，托勒密在体系中引入了被称为本轮的圆。行星沿着本轮做圆周运动，而本轮的中心则围绕地球做圆周运动。可以通过在等距轨道上添加等距轨道来进一步改进轨道，使得所得系统与行星位置的观测结果相符，并能够预测未来的行星位置。

The Aristotelian universe was divided into two distinct regions. The sub-lunar region was the inner region, extending from the central earth to just inside the moon’s orbit. The super-lunar region was the remainder of the finite universe, extending from the moon’s orbit to the sphere of the stars, which marked the outer boundary of the universe. Nothing existed beyond the outer sphere, not even space. Unfilled space is an impossibility in the Aristotelian system. All celestial objects in the super-lunar region were made of an incorruptible element called Ether. Ether possessed a natural propensity to move around the centre of the universe in perfect circles. This basic idea became modified and extended in Ptolemy’s astronomy. Since observations of planetary positions at various times could not be reconciled with circular, earth-centred orbits, Ptolemy introduced further circles, called epicycles, into the system. Planets moved in circles, or epicycles, the centres of which moved in circles around the earth. The orbits could be further refined by adding epicycles to epicycles in such a way that the resulting system was compatible with observations of planetary positions and capable of predicting future planetary positions.

与月球表面区域秩序井然、规整纯净的特性截然不同，月球下方区域则充满了变化、生长与衰败、生成与腐朽。月球下方区域的所有物质都是由气、土、火、水四种元素混合而成，混合物中各元素的相对比例决定了构成该物质的性质。每种元素在宇宙中都有其天然的位置。土的天然位置在宇宙中心；水的天然位置在地球表面；气的天然位置在地球表面上方；火的天然位置在大气层顶部，靠近月球轨道。因此，地球上的每种物体在月球下方区域也都有其天然的位置，这取决于它所包含的四种元素的相对比例。石头主要由土构成，因此其天然位置靠近地心；火焰主要由火构成，因此其天然位置靠近月球轨道，以此类推。所有物体都倾向于沿直线向上或向下运动，朝着其自然位置运动。因此，石头自然向下运动，朝向地心；火焰自然向上运动，远离地心。所有非自然运动都需要原因。例如，箭需要弓箭发射，战车需要马匹拉动。

In contrast to the orderly, regular, incorruptible character of the super-lunar region, the sub-lunar region was marked by change, growth and decay, generation and corruption. All substances in the sub-lunar region were mixtures of four elements, air, earth, fire and water, and the relative proportions of elements in a mixture determined the properties of the substance so constituted. Each element had a natural place in the universe. The natural place for earth was at the centre of the universe; for water, on the surface of the earth; for air, in the region immediately above the surface of the earth; and for fire, at the top of the atmosphere, close to the moon’s orbit. Consequently, each earthly object would have a natural place in the sub-lunar region depending on the relative proportion of the four elements that it contained. Stones, being mostly earth, have a natural place near the centre of the earth, whereas flames, being mostly fire, have a natural place near to the moon’s orbit, and so on. All objects have a propensity to move in straight lines, upwards or downwards, towards their natural place. Thus stones have a natural motion straight downwards, towards the centre of the earth, and flames have a natural motion straight upwards, away from the centre of the earth. All motions other than natural motions require a cause. For instance, arrows need to be propelled by a bow and chariots need to be drawn by horses.

以上便是亚里士多德力学和宇宙论的基本框架，这些框架被哥白尼的同代人所接受，并被用来反驳地球运动的观点。让我们来看一些反对哥白尼体系的有力论证。

These, then, are the bare bones of the Aristotelian mechanics and cosmology that were presupposed by contemporaries of Copernicus, and which were utilised in arguments against a moving earth. Let us look at some of the forceful arguments against the Copernican system.

或许对哥白尼理论构成最大威胁的论点就是所谓的“塔论证”。其逻辑如下：如果地球像哥白尼所说的那样绕轴自转，那么地球表面上的任何一点在一秒钟内都会移动相当远的距离。如果从一座建在自转地球上的塔顶扔下一块石头，它会按照自然运动轨迹落向地心。在这个过程中，由于地球自转，塔也会随之运动。因此，当石头到达地面时，塔的位置已经偏离了石头开始下落时的位置。石头应该落在距离塔底一定距离的地方。但实际情况并非如此。石头总是落在塔底。由此可见，地球不可能自转，哥白尼的理论是错误的。

Perhaps the argument that constituted the most serious threat to Copernicus was the so-called tower argument. It runs as follows. If the earth spins on its axis, as Copernicus had it, then any point on the earth’s surface will move a considerable distance in a second. If a stone is dropped from the top of a tower erected on the moving earth, it will execute its natural motion and fall towards the centre of the earth. While it is doing so the tower will be sharing the motion of the earth, due to its spinning. Consequently, by the time the stone reaches the surface of the earth the tower will have moved around from the position it occupied at the beginning of the stone’s downward journey. The stone should therefore strike the ground some distance from the foot of the tower. But this does not happen in practice. The stone strikes the ground at the base of the tower. It follows that the earth cannot be spinning and that Copernicus’s theory is false.

另一个反对哥白尼的机械论证涉及诸如石头和哲学家之类的散落物体，它们静静地躺在地球表面。如果地球自转，为什么这些物体不会像石头从旋转的轮子边缘被甩出去一样，从地球表面飞出去呢？如果地球除了自转之外还绕着太阳做整体运动，为什么它不会把月球甩在后面呢？

Another mechanical argument against Copernicus concerns loose objects such as stones and philosophers resting on the surface of the earth. If the earth spins, why are such objects not flung from the earth’s surface, as stones would be flung from the rim of a rotating wheel? And if the earth, as well as spinning, moves bodily around the sun, why doesn’t it leave the moon behind?

本书前面已经提到了一些基于天文考量的反对哥白尼的论点。这些论点包括观测到的恒星位置不存在视差，以及火星和金星用肉眼观察时，其大小在一年中变化不大。

Some arguments against Copernicus based on astronomical considerations have been mentioned earlier in this book. They involved the absence of parallax in the observed positions of the stars and the fact that Mars and Venus, as viewed by the naked eye, do not change size appreciably during the course of the year.

由于我提到的这些论点以及其他类似的论点，哥白尼理论的支持者面临着严重的困境。哥白尼本人深受亚里士多德形而上学的影响，对这些论点也无能为力。

Because of the arguments I have mentioned, and others like them, the supporters of the Copernican theory were faced with serious difficulties. Copernicus himself was very much immersed in Aristotelian metaphysics and had no adequate response to them.

鉴于反对哥白尼的论据如此有力，人们不禁要问，在1543年，哥白尼的理论究竟有何可取之处？答案是“几乎没有”。哥白尼理论的主要吸引力在于它巧妙地解释了行星运动的诸多特征，而与之竞争的托勒密理论只能以一种笨拙且人为的方式解释这些特征。这些特征包括行星的逆行运动，以及与其他行星不同，水星和金星始终位于太阳附近。行星会定期发生逆行，也就是说，它会停止在星空中（从地球上看）向西的运动，短暂地向东折返一段时间，然后再继续向西运行。在托勒密体系中，逆行运动是通过添加专门为此设计的本轮这一略显牵强的手段来解释的。而在哥白尼体系中，则无需这种人为的改动。逆行运动是地球和行星共同绕太阳在恒星背景下运行的自然结果。类似的道理也适用于太阳、水星和金星之间持续存在的近距离关系。在哥白尼体系中，一旦确定水星和金星的轨道位于地球轨道之内，这种近距离关系便成为自然结果。而在托勒密体系中，为了达到预期的结果，必须人为地将太阳、水星和金星的轨道联系起来。

In view of the strength of the case against Copernicus, it might well be asked just what there was to be said in favour of the Copernican theory in 1543. The answer is, ‘not very much’. The main attraction of the Copernican theory lay in the neat way it explained a number of features of planetary motion, which could be explained in the rival Ptolemaic theory only in an unattractive, artificial way. The features are the retrograde motion of the planets and the fact that, unlike the other planets, Mercury and Venus always remain in the proximity of the sun. A planet at regular intervals regresses, that is, stops its westward motion among the stars (as viewed from earth) and for a short time retraces its path eastward before continuing its journey westward once again. In the Ptolemaic system, retrograde motion was explained by the somewhat ad hoc manoeuvre of adding epicycles especially designed for the purpose. In the Copernican system, no such artificial move is necessary. Retrograde motion is a natural consequence of the fact that the earth and the planets together orbit the sun against the background of the fixed stars. Similar remarks apply to the problem of the constant proximity of the sun, Mercury and Venus. This is a natural consequence of the Copernican system once it is established that the orbits of Mercury and Venus are inside that of the earth. In the Ptolemaic system, the orbits of the sun, Mercury and Venus have to be artificially linked together to achieve the required result.

因此，哥白尼理论在某些数学特性上对其有利。除此之外，就简洁性和与行星位置观测结果的吻合度而言，这两个对立体系大致相当。以太阳为中心的圆形轨道无法与观测结果相符，因此哥白尼和托勒密一样，需要引入本轮，而为了使轨道与已知观测结果相符，这两个体系所需的本轮总数大致相同。在1543年，那些支持哥白尼的数学简洁性论证，不足以反驳那些反对他的机械论证和天文论证。尽管如此，许多具有数学才能的自然哲学家还是被哥白尼体系所吸引，并在接下来的大约一百年里，他们为捍卫这一体系所做的努力也越来越成功。

Thus there were some mathematical features of the Copernican theory that were in its favour. Apart from these, the two rival systems were more or less on a par as far as simplicity and accord with observations of planetary positions are concerned. Circular sun-centred orbits cannot be reconciled with observation, so that Copernicus, like Ptolemy, needed to add epicycles, and the total number of epicycles needed to produce orbits in accord with known observations was about the same for the two systems. In 1543 the arguments from mathematical simplicity that worked in favour of Copernicus could not be regarded as an adequate counter to the mechanical and astronomical arguments that worked against him. Nevertheless, a number of mathematically capable natural philosophers were to be attracted to the Copernican system, and their efforts to defend it became increasingly successful over the next hundred years or so.

对捍卫哥白尼体系贡献最大的人是伽利略。他从两个方面做出了贡献。首先，他利用望远镜观测天体，从而改变了哥白尼理论需要解释的观测数据。其次，他初步构建了一种新的力学理论，这种理论取代了亚里士多德力学，并以此驳斥了针对哥白尼的力学论证。

The person who contributed most significantly to the defence of the Copernican system was Galileo. He did so in two ways. First, he used a telescope to observe the heavens, and in so doing he transformed the observational data that the Copernican theory was required to explain. Second, he devised the beginnings of a new mechanics that was to replace Aristotelian mechanics and with reference to which the mechanical arguments against Copernicus were defused.

1609年，伽利略制造出他的第一架望远镜，并将其对准天空，取得了惊人的发现。他发现许多肉眼无法看到的恒星。他发现木星有卫星，并且发现地球的卫星——月球——的表面布满了山脉和陨石坑。他还观察到，通过望远镜观测，火星和金星的视大小变化与哥白尼体系的预测相符。后来，伽利略证实金星像月亮一样有盈亏变化，这一事实可以直接纳入哥白尼体系，但无法纳入托勒密体系。木星的卫星驳斥了亚里士多德基于月球始终伴随运动的地球这一论点而对哥白尼提出的质疑。至此，亚里士多德主义者在木星及其卫星的问题上也面临着同样的挑战。月球类似地球的表面动摇了亚里士多德关于完美无瑕、永恒不变的天体与变化无常、易腐朽的地球之间的区分。金星相位的发现标志着哥白尼学派的胜利，同时也给托勒密学派带来了新的难题。不可否认，一旦伽利略通过望远镜进行的观测被接受，哥白尼理论所面临的困难就会减少。

When, in 1609, Galileo constructed his first telescopes and trained them on the heavens, he made dramatic discoveries. He saw that there were many stars invisible to the naked eye. He saw that Jupiter has moons and he saw that the surface of the earth’s moon is covered with mountains and craters. He also observed that the apparent size of Mars and Venus, as viewed through the telescope, changed in the way predicted by the Copernican system. Later, Galileo was to confirm that Venus has phases like the moon, a fact that could be straightforwardly accommodated into the Copernican, but not the Ptolemaic, system. The moons of Jupiter defused the Aristotelian argument against Copernicus based on the fact that the moon stays with an allegedly moving earth. For now Aristotelians were faced with the same problem with respect to Jupiter and its moons. The earthlike surface of the moon undermined the Aristotelian distinction between the perfect, incorruptible heavens and the changing, corruptible earth. The discovery of the phases of Venus marked a success for the Copernicans and a new problem for the Ptolemaics. It is undeniable that once the observations made by Galileo through his telescope are accepted, the difficulties facing the Copernican theory are diminished.

上述关于伽利略和望远镜的论述引出了一个重要的认识论问题：为什么望远镜观测优于肉眼观测？对此，一种解释或许可以运用望远镜的光学理论，该理论能够阐明其放大特性，并阐述望远镜成像可能出现的各种像差。然而，伽利略本人并未为此目的运用光学理论。第一个能够为此提供论证的光学理论是由伽利略的同代人开普勒在十六世纪初提出的，并在随后的几十年中得到了改进和完善。另一种探讨望远镜观测优于肉眼观测的方法是，通过实际观测来证明望远镜的有效性，例如将其聚焦于远处的塔楼、船只等，并展示望远镜如何放大物体并使其更加清晰可见。然而，这种论证望远镜在天文学应用中的合理性存在一定的局限性。当用望远镜观测地球上的物体时，由于观测者熟悉塔楼、轮船等物体的外观，因此能够将观测到的物体与望远镜本身造成的像差区分开来。但当观测者漫无目的地仰望星空时，情况就不同了。值得注意的是，伽利略通过望远镜观察到的月球表面图中包含了一些实际上并不存在的陨石坑。这些“陨石坑”很可能是伽利略当时使用的望远镜远非完美时产生的像差。本段已经充分表明，望远镜观测的合理性并非易事。那些质疑伽利略发现的人并非都是愚蠢顽固的反动派。随着望远镜性能的不断提升和光学理论的不断发展，人们逐渐提出了各种合理的解释，并且这些解释也变得越来越充分。但这一切都需要时间。

The foregoing remarks on Galileo and the telescope raise a serious epistemological problem. Why should observations through a telescope be preferred to naked-eye observations? One answer to this question might utilise an optical theory of the telescope that explains its magnifying properties and that also gives an account of the various aberrations to which we can expect telescopic images to be subject. But Galileo himself did not utilise an optical theory for that purpose. The first optical theory capable of giving support in this direction was devised by Galileo’s contemporary, Kepler, early in the sixteenth century, and this theory was improved and augmented in later decades. A second way of facing our question concerning the superiority of telescopic to naked-eye observation is to demonstrate the effectiveness of the telescope in a practical way, by focusing it on distant towers, ships, etc. and demonstrating how the instrument magnifies and renders objects more distinctly visible. However, there is a difficulty with this kind of justification of the use of the telescope in astronomy. When terrestrial objects are viewed through a telescope, it is possible to separate the viewed object from aberrations contributed by the telescope because of the observer’s familiarity with what a tower, a ship, etc. look like. This does not apply when an observer searches the heavens for he knows not what. It is significant in this respect that Galileo’s drawing of the moon’s surface as he saw it through a telescope contains some craters that do not in fact exist there. Presumably those ‘craters’ were aberrations arising from the functioning of Galileo’s far-from-perfect telescopes. Enough has been said in this paragraph to indicate that the justification of telescopic observations was no simple, straightforward matter. Those adversaries of Galileo who queried his findings were not all stupid, stubborn reactionaries. Justifications were forthcoming, and became more and more adequate as better and better telescopes were constructed and as optical theories of their functioning were developed. But all this took time.

伽利略对科学最大的贡献在于他在力学领域的工作。他奠定了牛顿力学的部分基础，最终取代了亚里士多德的力学体系。他清晰地区分了速度和加速度，并断言自由落体运动的物体具有与自身重量无关的恒定加速度，其下落距离与下落时间的平方成正比。他否定了亚里士多德关于所有运动都必须有原因的观点。他认为，沿与地球同心的直线水平运动的物体，其速度既不会增加也不会减少，因为它既不是上升也不是下降。他通过将抛射体的运动分解为以恒定速度运动的水平分量和以恒定加速度向下运动的垂直分量，分析了抛体运动。他证明，抛射体的最终运动轨迹是一条抛物线。他发展了相对运动的概念，并指出，如果没有系统外部的参考点，就无法通过机械方法检测到系统的匀速水平运动。

Galileo’s greatest contribution to science was his work in mechanics. He laid some of the foundations of the Newtonian mechanics that was to replace Aristotle’s. He distinguished clearly between velocity and acceleration and asserted that freely falling objects move with a constant acceleration that is independent of their weight, dropping a distance proportional to the square of the time of fall. He denied the Aristotelian claim that all motion requires a cause. He argued that the velocity of an object moving horizontally, along a line concentric with the earth, should neither increase nor decrease since it is neither rising nor falling. He analysed projectile motion by resolving the motion of a projectile into a horizontal component moving with a constant velocity and a vertical component subject to a constant acceleration downwards. He showed that the resulting path of a projectile was a parabola. He developed the concept of relative motion and argued that the uniform, horizontal motion of a system could not be detected by mechanical means without access to some reference point outside of the system.

这些重大进展并非伽利略一蹴而就。它们历经半个世纪的逐步发展，最终汇集成他的著作《两门新科学》（1674年），该书初版于1638年，比哥白尼的巨著晚了近一个世纪。伽利略通过插图和思想实验，使他的新概念更具意义，也更加精确。有时，伽利略也会描述一些实际的实验，例如让球体沿斜面滚动的实验，但究竟有多少此类实验是他实际进行的，至今仍存在争议。

These major developments were not achieved instantaneously by Galileo. They emerged gradually over a period of half a century, culminating in his book Two New Sciences (1974), which was first published in 1638, almost a century after the publication of Copernicus’s major work. Galileo rendered his new conceptions meaningful and increasingly more precise by means of illustrations and thought experiments. Occasionally, Galileo described actual experiments, for instance experiments involving the rolling of spheres down inclined planes, although just how many of these Galileo actually performed is a matter of some dispute.

伽利略的新力学理论使哥白尼体系能够抵御上述一些反对意见。例如，一个物体被固定在塔顶，并与塔一起绕地心做圆周运动，那么即使物体被放下，它仍会与塔一起继续做圆周运动，最终落在塔底，这与经验相符。伽利略进一步论证，声称可以通过从匀速运动的船桅顶端扔下一块石头来证明他关于水平运动的观点是正确的，并观察石头是否会落在桅杆底部的甲板上，尽管伽利略并未声称自己做过这个实验。然而，伽利略在解释为什么松散的物体不会从旋转的地球表面被抛射出去方面则显得不太成功。

Galileo’s new mechanics enabled the Copernican system to be defended against some of the objections to it mentioned above. An object held at the top of a tower and sharing with the tower a circular motion around the earth’s centre will continue in that motion, along with the tower, after it is dropped and will consequently strike the ground at the foot of the tower, consistent with experience. Galileo took the argument further and claimed that the correctness of his views on horizontal motion could be demonstrated by dropping a stone from the top of the mast of a uniformly moving ship and noting that it strikes the deck at the foot of the mast, although Galileo did not claim to have performed the experiment. Galileo was less successful in explaining why loose objects are not flung from the surface of a spinning earth.

尽管伽利略的大部分科学工作旨在强化哥白尼的理论，但他本人并未构建一套详尽的天文学体系，而且似乎也倾向于亚里士多德学派的圆形轨道理论。伽利略的同代人开普勒在这方面做出了重大突破，他发现每个行星的轨道都可以用一个以太阳为焦点的椭圆来表示。这省去了哥白尼和托勒密都认为必要的复杂本轮系统。在托勒密的地心说体系中，类似的简化是不可能的。开普勒当时拥有第谷·布拉赫记录的行星位置数据，这些数据比哥白尼所掌握的更为精确。经过对数据的仔细分析，开普勒得出了行星运动的三大定律：行星绕太阳做椭圆轨道运动；连接行星和太阳的直线在相等的时间内覆盖相等的面积；行星周期的平方与其到太阳的平均距离的立方成正比。

Although the bulk of Galileo’s scientific work was designed to strengthen the Copernican theory, Galileo did not himself devise a detailed astronomy, and seemed to follow the Aristotelians in their preference for circular orbits. It was Galileo’s contemporary, Kepler, who contributed a major breakthrough in that direction when he discovered that each planetary orbit could be represented by a single ellipse, with the sun at one focus. This eliminated the complex system of epicycles that both Copernicus and Ptolemy had found necessary. No similar simplification is possible in the Ptolemaic, earth-centred system. Kepler had at his disposal Tycho Brahé’s recordings of planetary positions, which were more accurate than those available to Copernicus. After a painstaking analysis of the data, Kepler arrived at this three laws of planetary motion, that planets move in elliptical orbits around the sun, that a line joining a planet to the sun covers equal areas in equal times, and that the square of the period of a planet is proportional to the cube of its mean distance from the sun.

伽利略和开普勒无疑加强了哥白尼理论的论证。然而，在哥白尼理论建立在完善的物理学基础之上之前，还需要进一步的发展。牛顿充分利用了伽利略、开普勒等人的研究成果，构建了他于1687年发表的《自然哲学的数学原理》（Principia）中的完整物理学体系。他明确阐述了力是加速度而非运动的原因，这一概念在伽利略和开普勒的著作中虽有所体现，但表达方式较为模糊。牛顿用他的惯性定律取代了伽利略关于惯性的观点。根据惯性定律，物体将保持匀速直线运动，除非受到外力作用。牛顿的另一项重大贡献当然是他的万有引力定律。这一定律使牛顿能够解释开普勒行星运动定律和伽利略自由落体定律的近似正确性。在牛顿体系中，天体和地球的领域被统一起来，每一组天体都在力的作用下，按照牛顿运动定律运动。牛顿物理学建立之后，就可以将其详细应用于天文学。例如，可以研究月球轨道的细节，并考虑其有限的体积、地球的自转、地球绕轴的摆动等等。也可以研究由于太阳的有限质量、行星际作用力等原因，行星偏离开普勒定律的原因。诸如此类的研究成果在接下来的几个世纪里一直吸引着牛顿的一些后继者。

Galileo and Kepler certainly strengthened the case in favour of the Copernican theory. However, more developments were necessary before that theory was securely based on a comprehensive physics. Newton was able to take advantage of the work of Galileo, Kepler and others to construct the comprehensive physics that he published in his Principia in 1687. He spelt out a clear conception of force as the cause of acceleration rather than motion, a conception that had been present in a somewhat confused way in the writings of Galileo and Kepler. Newton replaced Galileo’s views on inertia with his law of linear inertia, according to which bodies continue to move in straight lines at uniform speed unless acted on by a force. Another major contribution by Newton was of course his law of gravitation. This enabled Newton to explain the approximate correctness of Kepler’s laws of planetary motion and Galileo’s law of free fall. In the Newtonian system, the realms of the celestial bodies and of earthly bodies were unified, each set of bodies moving under the influence of forces according to Newton’s laws of motion. Once Newton’s physics had been constituted, it was possible to apply it in detail to astronomy. It was possible, for instance, to investigate the details of the moon’s orbit, taking into account its finite size, the spin of the earth, the wobble of the earth upon its axis, and so on. It was also possible to investigate the departure of the planets from Kepler’s laws due to the finite mass of the sun, interplanetary forces, etc. Developments such as these were to occupy some of Newton’s successors for the next couple of centuries.

我在此概述的故事足以表明，哥白尼革命并非一蹴而就，也并非发生在比萨斜塔旁。同样显而易见的是，无论是归纳主义者还是证伪主义者，都无法对科学做出与其相符的解释。力和惯性的新概念并非源于细致的观察和实验，也并非通过证伪大胆的猜想并不断用新的猜想取而代之。新理论的早期表述，即便包含一些并不完善的新概念，也依然坚持发展，尽管它们似乎已被证伪。只有在新的物理体系被构建出来之后——这一过程凝聚了众多科学家几个世纪的智慧和实践——新理论才能与观察和实验的结果进行细致的比对。任何对科学的解释，如果不能涵盖这些因素，都不能被视为充分的。

The story I have sketched here should be sufficient to indicate that the Copernican Revolution did not take place at the drop of a hat or two from the Leaning Tower of Pisa. It is also clear that neither the inductivists nor the falsificationists give an account of science that is compatible with it. New concepts of force and inertia did not come about as a result of careful observation and experiment. Nor did they come about through the falsification of bold conjectures and the continual replacement of one bold conjecture by another. Early formulations of the new theory, involving imperfectly formulated novel conceptions, were persevered with and developed in spite of apparent falsifications. It was only after a new system of physics had been devised, a process that involved the intellectual and practical labour of many scientists over several centuries, that the new theory could be successfully matched with the results of observation and experiment in a detailed way. No account of science can be regarded as anywhere near adequate unless it can accommodate such factors.

证伪主义划界标准的不足之处及波普尔的回应

Inadequacies of the falsificationist demarcation criterion and Popper’s response

波普尔为他划分科学与非科学或伪科学的标准提出了一个颇具说服力的论证。科学理论应当是可证伪的，也就是说，它们应当具有可以通过观察或实验检验的推论。然而，如果不加限定，这一标准的一个缺陷在于它太容易被满足，尤其是一些知识主张——波普尔本人希望将其归类为非科学——也符合这一标准。占星家的确会提出一些可证伪的主张（而且这些主张经常被证伪），而报纸和期刊上刊登的星座运势也确实会提出一些可证伪的（以及不可证伪的）主张。例如，第五章中引用的那篇名为“你的星象”的报纸专栏文章，就曾预言“体育投机中也可能出现运气”，而这篇文章也曾向3月28日出生的人承诺“新的恋人会让你的双眼闪闪发光，并改善你的社交生活”，这显然是一个可证伪的承诺。任何坚持按字面意思理解《圣经》的基督教原教旨主义分支都是可以被证伪的。《创世记》中关于上帝创造海洋并使其充满鱼类的说法，如果根本不存在海洋和/或鱼类，那么就站不住脚了。波普尔本人也指出，弗洛伊德的理论，如果将梦境解释为愿望的实现，那么就面临着被噩梦证伪的威胁。

Popper made a seductive case for his criterion of demarcation between science and non- or pseudo-science. Scientific theories should be falsifiable, that is, they should have consequences that can be tested by observation or experiment. One weakness of this criterion, if unqualified, is that it is too easily satisfied and, in particular, satisfied by many knowledge claims that Popper, for one, would wish to classify as non-science. Astrologists do make claims that are falsifiable (and frequently falsified), while the horoscopes published in newspapers and journals do make falsifiable (as well as unfalsifiable) claims. The same ‘Your Stars’ newspaper column that yielded the (unfalsifiable) prediction that ‘luck is possible in sporting speculation’ quoted in chapter 5 also promised those whose birthday is on March 28 that ‘a new lover will put a sparkle in your eye and improve social activities’, a promise that is certainly falsifiable. Any fundamentalist brand of Christianity that insists that the Bible be taken literally is falsifiable. The claim in Genesis that God created the seas and populated them with fish would be falsified if there were no sea and/or no fish. Popper himself notes that Freudian theory, to the extent that it construes dreams as wish fulfilments, faces the threat of falsification by nightmares.

证伪主义者对这一观察的一种回应是，理论不仅必须是可证伪的，而且必须是不可证伪的。这或许会否定星座的科学性，波普尔认为这也能否定弗洛伊德的理论。但这种解决方案不能轻易采纳，否则它会否定证伪主义者想要保留的一切科学理论，因为我们已经看到，大多数科学理论都存在问题，并且与某些公认的观察结果相冲突。因此，在老练的证伪主义者看来，面对明显的证伪，修改理论是允许的，甚至可以在理论被证伪的情况下仍然坚持，希望将来能够解决这个问题。波普尔（1974，第55页）的以下段落就体现了这种回应，这是他试图解决我在此提出的这类难题。

One response that the falsificationist can give to this observation is to note that theories must not only be falsifiable, but must also be not falsified. This might eliminate the claims of horoscopes to be scientific, and Popper argues that it eliminates Freudian theory. But this solution cannot be adopted too readily lest it eliminate everything that the falsificationists wish to retain as scientific, for we have seen that most scientific theories have their problems and clash with some accepted observation or other. So it becomes allowable, according to the sophisticated falsificationist, to modify theories in the face of apparent falsifications, and even to hang on to theories in spite of falsifications in the hope that the problem can be solved in the future. This kind of response is captured in the following passage from Popper (1974, p. 55), which is an attempt by him to confront difficulties of the kind I am raising here.

我一直强调保持一定的教条主义是必要的：坚持教条的科学家扮演着重要的角色。如果我们太容易屈服于批评，我们就永远无法发现我们理论的真正力量所在。

I have always stressed the need for some dogmatism: the dogmatic scientist has an important role to play. If we give in to criticism too easily, we shall never find out where the real power of our theories lies.

我认为，这段文字恰恰说明了证伪主义在面对本章提出的各种批评时所面临的严峻挑战。证伪主义的核心在于强调科学的批判性。我们的理论应当经受无情的批判，以便剔除不完善的理论，并用更完善的理论取而代之。面对理论证伪的确定性问题，波普尔承认，即便某些理论表面上已被证伪，也常常需要保留它们。因此，尽管无情的批判受到提倡，但看似与之相反的教条主义也发挥着积极作用。人们不禁要问，一旦教条主义被允许扮演关键角色，证伪主义还剩下什么？此外，如果批判和教条的态度都可以被容忍，那么很难看出哪些态度会被排除在外。 （如果高度完善的证伪主义版本变得如此软弱，以至于什么都排除不了，从而与波普尔提出该理论的主要直觉相冲突，那将是多么具有讽刺意味啊！）

It is my view that this passage is illustrative of the extent to which falsificationism faces severe difficulties in the light of the kinds of criticism raised in this chapter. The thrust of falsificationism is to emphasise the critical component of science. Our theories are to be subject to ruthless criticism so that the inadequate ones can be weeded out and replaced by more adequate ones. Faced with the problems surrounding the degree of definiteness with which theories can be falsified, Popper admits that it is often necessary to retain theories in spite of apparent falsifications. So although ruthless criticism is recommended, what would appear to be its opposite, dogmatism, has a positive role to play too. One might well wonder what is left of falsificationism once dogmatism is allowed a key role. Further, if both a critical and a dogmatic attitude can be condoned, then it is difficult to see what attitudes are ruled out. (It would be ironic if the highly qualified version of falsificationism became so weak as to rule out nothing, thereby clashing with the main intuition that led Popper to formulate it!)

延伸阅读

Further reading

Schilpp (1974) 收录了对波普尔证伪主义的一系列批判。Lakatos (1970) 则对除最精妙的证伪主义流派之外的所有证伪主义流派进行了批判。本章中关于证伪主义与哥白尼革命不相容的许多观点均引自 Feyerabend (1975)。

A range of criticisms of Popper’s falsificationism are contained in Schilpp (1974). Criticism of all but the most sophisticated brand of falsificationism is marshalled in Lakatos (1970). Many of the points made in this chapter concerning the incompatibility of falsificationism with the Copernican Revolution were taken from Feyerabend (1975).

Lakatos 和 Musgrave (1970) 的文章对波普尔的立场与托马斯·库恩的立场进行了批判性的比较，库恩的观点将在下一章讨论。Mayo (1996) 对波普尔的立场也提出了一些细致的批评。

Lakatos and Musgrave (1970) contains articles that critically compare Popper’s position with those of Thomas Kuhn, whose views are discussed in the next chapter. There are some finely tuned criticisms of Popper’s position in Mayo (1996).

第八章

CHAPTER 8

理论作为结构 I：库恩的范式

Theories as structures I: Kuhn’s paradigms

理论作为结构

Theories as structures

前一章概述的哥白尼革命表明，归纳主义和证伪主义的科学理论过于零散。它们专注于理论与个别观察陈述或陈述集之间的关系，似乎未能把握主要理论发展模式的复杂性。自20世纪60年代以来，人们普遍认为，更充分的科学理论必须建立在对科学活动所处的理论框架的理解之上。接下来的三章将探讨三种基于此方法而产生的、具有影响力的科学理论。（在第13章中，我们将探讨“理论主导”的科学观是否走得太远。）

The sketch of the Copernican Revolution outlined in the previous chapter suggests that the inductivist and falsificationist accounts of science are too piecemeal. Concentrating on the relationship between theories and individual observation statements or sets of them, they seem to fail to grasp the complexity of the mode of development of major theories. Since the 1960s it has become common to conclude from this that a more adequate account of science must proceed from an understanding of the theoretical frameworks in which scientific activity takes place. The next three chapters are concerned with three influential accounts of science that have resulted from an adoption of this approach. (In chapter 13 we will have reason to question whether the ‘theory-dominated’ view of science has gone too far.)

将理论视为一种结构的必要性源于科学史。历史研究表明，主要科学的演进和发展展现出一种归纳主义和证伪主义理论无法捕捉的结构。哥白尼革命已为我们提供了例证。此外，我们还可以通过反思以下事实来强化这一观点：在牛顿之后的几个世纪里，物理学一直沿用牛顿框架，直到20世纪初相对论和量子理论的出现才对其提出挑战。然而，历史论证并非人们认为有必要关注理论框架的唯一原因。一个更普遍的哲学论证与观察如何依赖于理论密切相关。第一章强调，观察陈述必须用某种理论的语言表达。因此，有人认为，这些陈述及其所包含的概念，其精确性和信息量取决于构成它们的理论的精确性和信息量。例如，我认为人们会认同牛顿质量概念的含义比民主概念的含义更为精确。前者含义相对精确的原因在于，它在牛顿力学这一严谨的理论体系中扮演着明确而具体的角色。因此，例如，如何对质量进行恰当的测量取决于牛顿理论的规定。用弹簧秤测量质量是有问题的，因为质量和重量是不同的概念，重量取决于物体与地球质心的距离。

One reason why there is seen to be a need to view theories as structures stems from the history of science. Historical study reveals that the evolution and progress of major sciences exhibit a structure that is not captured by the inductivist and falsificationist accounts. The Copernican Revolution has already supplied us with an example. The notion can be further enhanced by reflecting on the fact that for a couple of centuries after Newton, physics was carried out in the Newtonian framework, until that framework was challenged by relativity and quantum theory at the beginning of the twentieth century. However, the historical argument is not the only reason why some have seen the need to concentrate on theoretical frameworks. A more general, philosophical argument is closely linked with the ways in which observation can be said to be theory-dependent. In chapter 1 it was stressed that observation statements must be expressed in the language of some theory. Consequently, it is argued, the statements, and the concepts figuring in them, will be as precise and informative as the theory in whose language they are formed is precise and informative. For instance, I think it will be agreed that the Newtonian concept of mass has a more precise meaning than the concept of democracy, say. It is plausible to suggest that the reason for the relatively precise meaning of the former stems from the fact that the concept plays a specific, well-defined role in a precise, closely knit theory, Newtonian mechanics. So, for instance, what counts as an adequate measurement of mass is dependent on the dictates of Newtonian theory. Measurement of mass via a spring balance is problematic because mass and weight are distinct, the latter being dependent on the distance of a massive object from the centre of gravity of the earth.

概念的意义依赖于其所在理论的结构，而概念的精确性又依赖于理论的精确性和连贯性，这种依赖性可以通过指出一些概念获得意义的替代方式的局限性来解释。其中一种替代观点认为，概念通过定义获得意义。然而，定义作为确立意义的根本方式必须被摒弃，因为概念只能用其他概念来定义，而这些概念的意义是已知的。如果这些概念的意义本身也是通过定义来确立的，那么显然，除非我们通过其他方式了解某些概念的意义，否则就会陷入无限循环。如果我们已经知道许多单词的含义，那么字典就毫无用处。牛顿无法用先前已有的概念来定义质量或力。他必须超越旧概念框架的局限，发展出一个新的框架。另一种替代观点认为，概念通过指示性定义获得意义。我们在第一章讨论孩子学习“苹果”含义时就看到，即使像“苹果”这样基本的概念，这种说法也很难成立。而对于力学中的“质量”或电磁学中的“电场”这类概念的定义，这种说法就更加站不住脚了。

The dependence of the meaning of concepts on the structure of the theory in which they occur, and the dependence of the precision of the former on the precision and degree of coherence of the latter, can be made plausible by noting the limitations of some of the alternative ways in which a concept might be thought to acquire meaning. One such alternative is the view that concepts acquire their meaning by way of a definition. Definitions must be rejected as a fundamental way of establishing meanings because concepts can only be defined in terms of other concepts, the meanings of which are given. If the meanings of these latter concepts are themselves established by definition, it is clear that an infinite regress will result unless the meanings of some concepts are known by other means. A dictionary is useless unless we already know the meanings of many words. Newton could not define mass or force in terms of previously available concepts. It was necessary for him to transcend the limits of the old conceptual framework by developing a new one. A second alternative is the suggestion that concepts acquire their meaning by way of ostensive definition. We saw, in our discussion of a child learning the meaning of ‘apple’ in chapter 1, that this is difficult to sustain even in the case of an elementary notion like ‘apple’. It is even more implausible when it comes to the definition of something like ‘mass’ in mechanics or ‘electric field’ in electromagnetism.

认为概念的意义至少部分来源于其在理论中所扮演的角色这一论断，可以从以下历史反思中得到佐证。与流行的说法相反，实验绝非伽利略力学创新的关键。他在阐述其理论时所提及的许多“实验”实际上是思想实验。对于那些认为新理论源于实验的人来说，这似乎自相矛盾，但如果我们认同只有拥有能够以精确观察陈述的形式做出预测的精确理论，才能进行精确的实验，那么这种矛盾就很容易理解了。可以说，伽利略当时正在为构建一种新的力学体系做出重大贡献，而这种新体系在后来的阶段将被证明能够支撑详细的实验。因此，他的努力更多地依赖于思想实验、类比和阐释性的隐喻，而非详细的实验，也就不足为奇了。我们可以这样论证：一个概念的典型发展历程，无论是“化学元素”、“原子”、“无意识”还是其他任何概念，都包含着这样一个过程：最初，该概念以模糊不清的形式出现；随后，随着它所处的理论体系日趋精确和连贯，该概念也逐渐被清晰化。电场概念的出现就印证了这种观点。法拉第在十九世纪上半叶首次提出电场概念时，它非常模糊，需要借助机械类比来阐述，例如拉紧的弦，以及“张力”、“功率”和“力”等术语的隐喻用法。随着电场与其他电磁量之间关系的日益明确，电场概念也变得越来越清晰。麦克斯韦引入位移电流后，再次借助力学类比，便得以构建出麦克斯韦方程组，使理论更加连贯统一。这些方程组清晰地阐明了所有电磁量之间的相互关系。不久之后，人们便不再需要以太——此前被认为是场的机械载体——从而使场本身成为清晰明确的概念。

The claim that concepts derive their meaning at least in part from the role they play in a theory can be given support by the following historical reflections. Contrary to popular myth, experiment was by no means the key to Galileo’s innovations in mechanics. Many of the ‘experiments’ he refers to in articulating his theory are thought experiments. This can appear paradoxical for those who see novel theories arising as a result of experiment, but it is quite comprehensible if it is accepted that precise experimentation can only be carried out if one has a precise theory capable of yielding predictions in the form of precise observation statements. Galileo, it might be argued, was in the process of making a major contribution to the building of a new mechanics that was to prove capable of supporting detailed experimentation at a later stage. It need not be surprising that his efforts involved thought experiments, analogies and illustrative metaphors rather than detailed experimentation. A case could be made to the effect that the typical history of a concept, whether it be ‘chemical element’, ‘atom’, ‘the unconscious’ or whatever, involves the initial emergence of the concept as a vague idea, followed by its gradual clarification as the theory in which it plays a part takes a more precise and coherent form. The emergence of the concept of an electric field can be construed in a way that supports such a view. When the concept was first introduced by Faraday in the first half of the nineteenth century it was very vague, and was articulated with the aid of mechanical analogies involving such things as stretched strings and metaphorical uses of such terms as ‘tension’, ‘power’ and ‘force’. The field concept became increasingly better defined as the relationship between the electric field and other electromagnetic quantities became more clearly specified. Once Maxwell had introduced his displacement current, again with the aid of mechanical analogies, it was possible to bring great coherence to the theory in the form of Maxwell’s equations, which clearly specified the interrelationship between all the electromagnetic quantities. It was not long before the ether, which had been considered to be the mechanical seat of the fields, could be dispensed with, leaving the fields as clearly defined concepts in their own right.

在本节中，我尝试构建一种以科学工作和论证所处的理论框架为基础来研究科学的理论基础。在本章及接下来的两章中，我们将探讨三位重要的科学哲学家如何践行这一理念。

In this section I have attempted to construct a rationale for approaching science by way of the theoretical frameworks within which scientific work and argumentation take place. In this and the following two chapters we look at the work of three important philosophers of science who have pursued this idea.

托马斯·库恩简介

Introducing Thomas Kuhn

托马斯·库恩（1970a）在其著作《科学革命的结构》中对归纳主义和证伪主义的科学理论提出了重大挑战。该书 初版于1962年，八年后附有阐释性后记再版。自此，他的观点在科学哲学领域持续产生深远影响。库恩的学术生涯始于物理学，之后转向科学史研究。在此过程中，他发现自己对科学本质的固有观念被彻底颠覆。他开始相信，无论是归纳主义还是证伪主义的传统科学理论都无法与历史证据相符。库恩的科学理论随后发展完善，旨在构建一个更符合他所理解的历史情境的理论。该理论的一个关键特征是强调科学进步的革命性，即革命意味着放弃一种理论结构，并代之以另一种不相容的理论结构。另一个重要特征是科学共同体的社会学特征所扮演的重要角色。

Inductivist and falsificationist accounts of science were challenged in a major way by Thomas Kuhn (1970a) in his book The Structure of Scientific Revolutions, first published in 1962, and then republished with a clarificatory Postscript eight years later. His views have reverberated in the philosophy of science ever since. Kuhn started his academic career as a physicist and then turned his attention to the history of science. On doing so, he found that his preconceptions about the nature of science were shattered. He came to believe that traditional accounts of science, whether inductivist or falsificationist, do not bear comparison with historical evidence. Kuhn’s account of science was subsequently developed as an attempt to give a theory more in keeping with the historical situation as he saw it. A key feature of his theory is the emphasis placed on the revolutionary character of scientific progress, where a revolution involves the abandonment of one theoretical structure and its replacement by another, incompatible one. Another important feature is the important role played by the sociological characteristics of scientific communities.

库恩对科学发展方式的描述可以用以下开放式方案来概括：

Kuhn’s picture of the way a science progresses can be summarised by the following open-ended scheme:

前科学——常规科学——危机——革命——新常规科学——新危机——

pre-science – normal science – crisis – revolution – new normal science – new crisis –

在科学形成之前，各种零散且多元的活动最终会变得结构化和有方向性，而当一个科学共同体坚持单一范式时，这种结构化和有方向性的活动便会形成。范式由特定科学共同体成员所采纳的一般理论假设、定律及其应用技术构成。遵循范式的研究人员，无论是牛顿力学、波动光学、分析化学或其他任何领域，都在实践库恩所谓的“常规科学”。 常规科学家会阐述和发展范式，试图解释和适应现实世界中某些相关现象的实验结果。在此过程中，他们不可避免地会遇到困难，并遭遇看似证伪的现象。如果这类困难失控，就会引发危机。当一个全新的范式出现，并吸引越来越多的科学家加入，最终导致原有的、问题重重的范式被抛弃时，危机便得以解决。这种非连续性的变革构成了一场科学革命。 新的范式充满希望，而且似乎没有遇到无法克服的困难，它现在指导着新的常态科学活动，直到它也遇到了严重的麻烦，并引发了一场新的危机和一场新的革命。

The disorganised and diverse activity that precedes the formation of a science eventually becomes structured and directed when a single paradigm becomes adhered to by a scientific community. A paradigm is made up of the general theoretical assumptions and laws and the techniques for their application that the members of a particular scientific community adopt. Workers within a paradigm, whether it be Newtonian mechanics, wave optics, analytical chemistry or whatever, practise what Kuhn calls normal science. Normal scientists will articulate and develop the paradigm in their attempt to account for and accommodate the behaviour of some relevant aspects of the real world as revealed through the results of experimentation. In doing so, they will inevitably experience difficulties and encounter apparent falsifications. If difficulties of that kind get out of hand, a crisis state develops. A crisis is resolved when an entirely new paradigm emerges and attracts the allegiance of more and more scientists until eventually the original, problem-ridden paradigm is abandoned. The discontinuous change constitutes a scientific revolution. The new paradigm, full of promise and not beset by apparently insuperable difficulties, now guides new normal scientific activity until it too runs into serious trouble and a new crisis followed by a new revolution results.

有了这份概要作为预告，让我们更详细地了解一下库恩方案的各个组成部分。

With this resumé as a foretaste, let us look at the various components of Kuhn’s scheme in more detail.

范式与常规科学

Paradigms and normal science

成熟的科学由单一范式所支配。<sup>1 </sup> 范式为其所支配的科学领域内的合法工作设定标准。它协调并指导在其框架内工作的正规科学家群体的“解谜”活动。库恩认为，能够支撑正规科学传统的范式的存在，是区分科学与非科学的特征。牛顿力学、波动光学和经典电磁学都曾是（或许现在仍然是）范式，并符合科学的定义。现代社会学的大部分内容缺乏范式，因此不符合科学的定义。

A mature science is governed by a single paradigm.1 The paradigm sets the standards for legitimate work within the science it governs. It coordinates and directs the ‘puzzle-solving’ activity of the groups of normal scientists who work within it. The existence of a paradigm capable of supporting a normal science tradition is the characteristic that distinguishes science from non-science, according to Kuhn. Newtonian mechanics, wave optics and classical electromagnetism all constituted and perhaps constitute paradigms and qualify as sciences. Much of modern sociology lacks a paradigm and consequently fails to qualify as science.

如下文所述，范式的本质决定了它难以精确定义。尽管如此，我们仍然可以描述构成范式的一些典型组成部分。这些组成部分包括明确阐述的基本定律和理论假设。例如，牛顿运动定律构成牛顿范式的一部分，而麦克斯韦方程组则构成经典电磁理论范式的一部分。范式还包含将这些基本定律应用于各种情况的标准方法。例如，牛顿范式包含将牛顿定律应用于行星运动、摆、台球碰撞等情况的方法。此外，将范式定律应用于现实世界所需的仪器和仪器技术也包含在范式之中。牛顿范式在天文学中的应用涉及使用各种经认可的望远镜，以及相应的操作技术和数据校正技术。范式的另一个组成部分是一些非常普遍的形而上学原则，这些原则指导着范式内的工作。整个十九世纪，牛顿范式都基于这样一个假设：“整个物理世界都可以被解释为一个机械系统，它在各种力的作用下，按照牛顿运动定律运行。”而十七世纪的笛卡尔纲领则包含这样的原则：“不存在虚空，物理宇宙就像一个巨大的钟表装置，其中所有力都表现为推力。”最后，所有范式都包含一些非常普遍的方法论指导，例如“认真尝试使你的范式与自然相符”，或者“将范式与自然相符的失败视为严重的问题”。

As will be explained below, it is of the nature of a paradigm to belie precise definition. Nevertheless, it is possible to describe some of the typical components that go to make up a paradigm. Among the components will be explicitly stated fundamental laws and theoretical assumptions. Thus Newton’s laws of motion form part of the Newtonian paradigm and Maxwell’s equations form part of the paradigm that constitutes classical electromagnetic theory. Paradigms will also include standard ways of applying the fundamental laws to a variety of types of situation. For instance, the Newtonian paradigm will include methods of applying Newton’s laws to planetary motion, pendulums, billiard-ball collisions, and so on. Instrumentation and instrumental techniques necessary for bringing the laws of the paradigm to bear on the real world will also be included in the paradigm. The application of the Newtonian paradigm in astronomy involves the use of a variety of approved kinds of telescope, together with techniques for their use and a variety of techniques for the correction of the data collected with their aid. A further component of paradigms consists of some very general, metaphysical principles that guide work within a paradigm. Throughout the nineteenth century the Newtonian paradigm was governed by an assumption something like, ‘The whole of the physical world is to be explained as a mechanical system operating under the influence of various forces according to the dictates of Newton’s laws of motion’, and the Cartesian program in the seventeenth century involved the principle, ‘There is no void and the physical universe is a big clockwork in which all forces take the form of a push’. Finally, all paradigms will contain some very general methodological prescriptions such as, ‘Make serious attempts to match your paradigm with nature’, or ‘Treat failures in attempts to match a paradigm with nature as serious problems’.

常规科学涉及对范式进行细致的阐释，旨在提高范式与自然的契合度。范式本身必然存在一定的不精确性和开放性，从而留下大量此类工作待完成。库恩将常规科学描绘成一种受范式规则约束的解谜活动。这些谜题既有理论性的，也有实验性的。例如，在牛顿范式下，典型的理论谜题包括设计数学方法来处理受多种引力作用的行星运动，以及建立适用于将牛顿定律应用于流体运动的假设。实验谜题则包括提高望远镜观测的精度，以及开发能够可靠测量万有引力常数的实验技术。常规科学家必须预设范式为解决其中提出的谜题提供了途径。未能解决某个谜题被视为科学家的失败，而非范式的不足。那些无法解决的难题被视为异常现象，而不是对某种范式的证伪。库恩认识到，所有范式都会包含一些异常现象（例如哥白尼理论与金星的视大小，或牛顿范式与水星的轨道），并拒绝一切形式的证伪主义。

Normal science involves detailed attempts to articulate a paradigm with the aim of improving the match between it and nature. A paradigm will always be sufficiently imprecise and open-ended to leave plenty of that kind of work to be done. Kuhn portrays normal science as a puzzle-solving activity governed by the rules of a paradigm. The puzzles will be of both a theoretical and an experimental nature. Within the Newtonian paradigm, for instance, typical theoretical puzzles involve devising mathematical techniques for dealing with the motion of a planet subject to more than one attractive force, and developing assumptions suitable for applying Newton’s laws to the motion of fluids. Experimental puzzles included the improvement of the accuracy of telescopic observations and the development of experimental techniques capable of yielding reliable measurements of the gravitational constant. Normal scientists must presuppose that a paradigm provides the means for the solution of the puzzles posed within it. A failure to solve a puzzle is seen as a failure of the scientist rather than as an inadequacy of the paradigm. Puzzles that resist solution are seen as anomalies rather than as falsifications of a paradigm. Kuhn recognises that all paradigms will contain some anomalies (for example the Copernican theory and the apparent size of Venus or the Newtonian paradigm and the orbit of Mercury) and rejects all brands of falsificationism.

正常的科学家必须对他们所处的范式保持客观中立。只有这样，他们才能集中精力对范式进行细致的阐述，并开展深入探究自然所必需的深奥工作。正是对基本原理缺乏分歧，才将成熟的、正常的科学与相对混乱的、不成熟的前科学活动区分开来。库恩认为，后者以对基本原理的全面分歧和持续不断的争论为特征，以至于根本无法进行细致的、深奥的工作。理论的数量几乎与该领域的研究人员一样多，每个理论家都不得不从头开始，并为其特定的方法辩护。库恩以牛顿之前的光学为例。从古代到牛顿，关于光的本质存在着各种各样的理论。在牛顿提出并捍卫他的粒子理论之前，没有达成普遍共识，也没有出现任何详细且被普遍接受的理论。前科学时期的理论家们不仅在基本理论假设上存在分歧，而且在与各自理论相关的观测现象类型上也存在分歧。库恩承认范式在指导对可观测现象的探索和解释中所起的作用，因此他也认可了观测和实验在某种程度上可以被认为依赖于理论的观点。

Normal scientists must be uncritical of the paradigm in which they work. It is only by being so that they are able to concentrate their efforts on the detailed articulation of the paradigm and to perform the esoteric work necessary to probe nature in depth. It is the lack of disagreement over fundamentals that distinguishes mature, normal science from the relatively disorganised activity of immature pre-science. According to Kuhn, the latter is characterised by total disagreement and constant debate over fundamentals, so much so that it is impossible to get down to detailed, esoteric work. There will be almost as many theories as there are workers in the field and each theoretician will be obliged to start afresh and justify his or her own particular approach. Kuhn offers optics before Newton as an example. There was a wide diversity of theories about the nature of light from the time of the ancients up to Newton. No general agreement was reached and no detailed, generally accepted theory emerged before Newton proposed and defended his particle theory. The rival theorists of the pre-science period disagreed not only over fundamental theoretical assumptions but also over the kinds of observational phenomena that were relevant to their theories. Insofar as Kuhn recognises the role played by a paradigm in guiding the search for and interpretation of observable phenomena, he accommodates the sense in which observation and experiment can be said to be theory-dependent.

库恩坚持认为，范式的内涵远不止于那些能够以明确规则和方向形式清晰阐述的内容。他援引维特根斯坦关于“游戏”概念的讨论来阐明他的观点。维特根斯坦认为，我们无法明确列出某项活动成为“游戏”的必要和充分条件。当我们试图这样做时，总会发现一些活动虽然包含在我们的定义中，但我们并不想将其视为“游戏”；或者一些活动虽然被我们的定义排除在外，但我们却希望将其视为“游戏”。库恩认为，范式也存在同样的情况。如果我们试图对科学史或当代科学中的某个范式进行精确而明确的描述，最终总会发现该范式内部的某些工作违背了这种描述。然而，库恩坚持认为，这种情况并不会使“范式”概念本身站不住脚，正如“游戏”概念的类似情况并不排除其合法使用一样。尽管没有完整、明确的描述，但科学家通过科学教育获得对某一范式的了解。通过解决标准问题、进行标准实验，最终在一位在该范式内经验丰富的导师指导下开展研究，有志成为科学家的学生会逐渐熟悉该范式的方法、技术和标准。正如技艺精湛的木匠无法完全描述其技艺背后的原理一样，有志成为科学家的学生也无法清晰地阐述自己所掌握的方法和技能。正如迈克尔·波兰尼（Michael Polanyi，1973）所阐述的那样，普通科学家的大部分知识都是隐性知识。

Kuhn insists that there is more to a paradigm than what can be explicitly laid down in the form of explicit rules and directions. He invokes Wittgenstein’s discussion of the notion of ‘game’ to illustrate some of what he means. Wittgenstein argued that it is not possible to spell out necessary and sufficient conditions for an activity to be a game. When one tries, one invariably finds an activity that one’s definition includes but that one would not want to count as a game, or an activity that the definition excludes but that one would want to count as a game. Kuhn claims that the same situation exists with respect to paradigms. If one tries to give a precise and explicit characterisation of some paradigm in the history of science or in present-day science, it always turns out that some work within the paradigm violates the characterisation. However, Kuhn insists that this state of affairs does not render the concept of paradigm untenable any more than the similar situation with respect to ‘game’ rules out legitimate use of that concept. Even though there is no complete, explicit characterisation, individual scientists acquire knowledge of a paradigm through their scientific education. By solving standard problems, performing standard experiments and eventually by doing a piece of research under a supervisor who is already a skilled practitioner within the paradigm, an aspiring scientist becomes acquainted with the methods, the techniques and the standards of that paradigm. The aspiring scientist will be no more able to give an explicit account of the methods and skills he or she has acquired than a master-carpenter will be able to fully describe what lies behind his or her skills. Much of the normal scientist’s knowledge will be tacit, in the sense developed by Michael Polanyi (1973).

由于他们接受的训练方式（以及为了高效工作而必须接受的训练），典型的普通科学家往往意识不到也无法清晰阐述他们所处范式的确切本质。然而，这并不意味着科学家在必要时就无法阐明该范式所涉及的前提。当一个范式受到竞争对手的威胁时，这种需求就会出现。在这种情况下，科学家必须尝试阐明该范式所涉及的一般规律、形而上学原理和方法论原则，以捍卫其免受新范式的挑战。下一节将概述库恩关于范式如何陷入困境并被竞争对手取代的论述。

Because of the way they are trained, and need to be trained if they are to work efficiently, typical normal scientists will be unaware of and unable to articulate the precise nature of the paradigm in which they work. However, it does not follow from this that a scientist will not be able to articulate the presuppositions involved in the paradigm should the need arise. Such a need will arise when a paradigm is threatened by a rival. In those circumstances, it will be necessary to attempt to spell out the general laws and metaphysical and methodological principles involved in a paradigm in order to defend them against the alternatives involved in the threatening new paradigm. The next section summarises Kuhn’s account of how a paradigm can run into trouble and be replaced by a rival.

危机与革命

Crisis and revolution

普通科学家在既定范式所界定的明确领域内自信地开展工作。该范式为他们呈现一系列明确的问题，以及他们确信足以解决这些问题的方法。如果他们将问题解决失败归咎于范式，他们就会像木匠责怪工具一样，受到同样的指责。然而，失败终究会发生，而且这些失败最终可能会发展到足以构成范式危机的严重程度，甚至可能导致该范式被摒弃，并被不相容的替代方案所取代。

Normal scientists work confidently within a well-defined area dictated by a paradigm. The paradigm presents them with a set of definite problems together with methods that they are confident will be adequate for the solution of the problems. If they blame the paradigm for any failure to solve a problem, they will be open to the same charges as the carpenter who blames his tools. Nevertheless, failures will be encountered and such failures can eventually attain a degree of seriousness that constitutes a serious crisis for the paradigm and may lead to the rejection of a paradigm and its replacement by an incompatible alternative.

范式内部存在未解之谜本身并不构成危机。库恩承认，范式总会遇到困难，总会有反常现象。只有在特定的条件下，这些反常现象才会发展到足以动摇人们对范式信心的程度。如果某种反常现象被认为触及了范式的根本，并且持续地抵抗着主流科学界试图消除它的努力，那么这种反常现象将被视为特别严重。库恩以麦克斯韦电磁理论中与以太以及地球相对于以太的运动相关的问题为例，指出……十九世纪末期，彗星对亚里士多德有序且完整的、相互连接的晶体球体宇宙模型构成了挑战，这是一个不太专业的例子。如果异常现象与某些紧迫的社会需求密切相关，也会被视为严重的问题。例如，托勒密天文学所面临的问题，在哥白尼时代，由于历法改革的迫切需要，就显得尤为紧迫。此外，异常现象持续的时间长短也会影响其严重程度。严重异常现象的数量也是影响危机爆发的另一个因素。

The mere existence of unsolved puzzles within a paradigm does not constitute a crisis. Kuhn recognises that paradigms will always encounter difficulties. There will always be anomalies. It is only under special sets of conditions that the anomalies can develop in such a way as to undermine confidence in the paradigm. An anomaly will be regarded as particularly serious if it is seen as striking at the very fundamentals of a paradigm and yet persistently resists attempts by the members of the normal scientific community to remove it. Kuhn cites as an example problems associated with the ether and the earth’s motion relative to it in Maxwell’s electromagnetic theory, towards the end of the nineteenth century. A less-technical example would be the problems that comets posed for the ordered and full Aristotelian cosmos of interconnected crystalline spheres. Anomalies are also regarded as serious if they are important with respect to some pressing social need. The problems that beset Ptolemaic astronomy were pressing ones in the light of the need for calendar reform at the time of Copernicus. Also bearing on the seriousness of an anomaly will be the length of time that it resists attempts to remove it. The number of serious anomalies is a further factor influencing the onset of a crisis.

库恩认为，对科学危机时期特征的分析，既需要历史学家的专业素养，也需要心理学家的专业素养。当异常现象被视为对现有范式构成严重挑战时，便会进入一段“明显的职业不安全感”时期。解决问题的尝试变得越来越激进，而范式为解决问题设定的规则也逐渐被打破。普通科学家开始参与哲学和形而上学的争论，并试图用哲学论证来捍卫他们那些在现有范式看来地位存疑的创新。科学家们甚至开始公开表达他们对主流范式的不满和不安。库恩（1970a，第84页）引用了沃尔夫冈·泡利在1924年前后对当时物理学界日益严重的危机的回应。恼怒的泡利向一位朋友坦白道：“现在物理学又乱成一团了。反正对我来说太难了，我真希望自己是个喜剧演员之类的，从来没听说过物理学。”一旦某种范式被削弱和动摇到其拥护者对其失去信心的程度，革命的时机就成熟了。

According to Kuhn, an analysis of the characteristics of a crisis period in science demands the competence of the psychologist as much as that of the historian. When anomalies come to be seen as posing serious problems for a paradigm, a period of ‘pronounced professional insecurity’ sets in. Attempts to solve the problem become more and more radical and the rules set by the paradigm for the solution of problems become progressively more loosened. Normal scientists begin to engage in philosophical and metaphysical disputes and try to defend their innovations, of dubious status from the point of view of the paradigm, by philosophical arguments. Scientists even begin to express openly their discontent with and unease over the reigning paradigm. Kuhn (1970a, p. 84) quotes Wolfgang Pauli’s response to what he saw as the growing crisis in physics around 1924. An exasperated Pauli confessed to a friend, ‘At the moment, physics is again terribly confused. In any case, it is too difficult for me, and I wish I had been a movie comedian or something of the sort and had never heard of physics’. Once a paradigm has been weakened and undermined to such an extent that its proponents lose their confidence in it, the time is ripe for revolution.

当一种新的范式出现时，危机的严重性便会加剧。库恩（1970a，第91页）指出，“新范式，或者足以使其日后得以阐明的线索，会突然出现，有时甚至在深夜，出现在一个深陷危机之中的人的脑海中”。新范式将与旧范式截然不同，并且彼此不相容。这种根本性的差异体现在方方面面。

The seriousness of a crisis deepens when a rival paradigm makes its appearance. According to Kuhn (1970a, p. 91), ‘the new paradigm, or a sufficient hint to permit later articulation, emerges all at once, sometimes in the middle of the night, in the mind of a man deeply immersed in crisis’. The new paradigm will be very different from and incompatible with the old one. The radical differences will be of a variety of kinds.

每一种范式都将世界视为由不同种类的物质构成。亚里士多德的范式认为宇宙分为两个截然不同的领域：不可腐朽、永恒不变的月球之上的区域，以及易腐朽、不断变化的地球区域。后来的范式则认为整个宇宙由同一种物质构成。拉瓦锡之前的化学理论认为，世界包含一种名为燃素的物质，它会在物质燃烧时释放出来。拉瓦锡的新范式则认为燃素并不存在，而氧气这种气体确实存在，并且在燃烧过程中扮演着截然不同的角色。麦克斯韦的电磁理论认为以太占据了整个空间，而爱因斯坦的彻底重构则否定了以太的存在。

Each paradigm will regard the world as being made up of different kinds of things. The Aristotelian paradigm saw the universe as divided into two distinct realms, the incorruptible and unchanging super-lunar region and the corruptible and changing earthly region. Later paradigms saw the entire universe as being made up of the same kinds of material substances.
