Attention to the details shows the extent to which Perrin established the molecular constitution of gases by powerful arguments from coincidence, that his observations were not theory-dependent in a way that posed any kind of problem, and that the kinetic theory he defended was false in certain respects nevertheless.

1827年，英国博物学家罗伯特·布朗首次通过显微镜观察到悬浮在液体中的微小粒子的剧烈运动。到了19世纪末，物理学家们开始怀疑，后来被称为布朗运动的现象与动力学理论中假定的流体分子运动之间存在某种联系。支持这一观点的证据包括：布朗运动看似无序，其持续存在却又找不到明显的原因，以及它与由振动和局部加热等外部因素引起的协调运动截然不同。正如我在下文分析的那样，佩兰的实验无可辩驳地证明了布朗粒子的运动确实是由它们所悬浮的液体分子碰撞引起的。

In 1827 the British naturalist Robert Brown first observed through a microscope the agitated motion of minute particles suspended in a fluid. By late in the nineteenth century physicists suspected a link between what has become known as Brownian motion and the motions attributed to the molecules of fluids assumed in the kinetic theory. In support of this idea was the apparently chaotic nature of the motion, its persistence without an apparent cause and the extent to which it could be readily distinguished from the coordinated motions caused by external causes such as vibrations and local heating. In the way I analyse below, Perrin’s experiments left no room for doubting that the motions of Brownian particles are indeed caused by collisions with molecules of the liquid in which they are suspended.

为了把握佩兰论证的逻辑，我将以比佩兰实际所做的更系统的方式，一方面将他的实验和他能够从中识别出的布朗运动特征分开，另一方面将他如何利用他的实验结果来论证动力学理论分开。

To capture the logic of Perrin’s argument I will, in a more systematic way than Perrin in fact did, separate his experiments and the features of Brownian motion he was able to identify with them, on the one hand, and the way in which he could use his results to argue for the kinetic theory, on the other.

佩兰利用1903年发明的超显微镜，得以近距离观察布朗粒子。¹他通过多种独立的方法证明了这些粒子的运动确实是随机的。尽管构成布朗粒子的树脂密度大于悬浮液，但布朗粒子却能无限期地保持悬浮状态而不沉到容器底部，这需要解释。后来，人们认识到单位体积内悬浮的布朗粒子数量随高度的增加而减少，从而找到了解释。基于此，粒子的随机运动会产生向上的压力，因为从下方撞击悬浮液水平层的粒子数量略大于从上方撞击的粒子数量。当这种向上的压力与粒子向下作用的重力达到平衡时，就达到了平衡状态。佩兰通过实验证明，一旦达到热平衡（大约三个小时后），粒子的密度分布确实会无限期地保持不变。

Perrin was able to closely observe Brownian particles using the ultra-microscope, invented in 1903.1 By a number of independent methods Perrin was able to show that the motions were indeed random. An explanation was needed for the fact that the Brownian particles remained in suspension indefinitely and did not sink to the bottom of the container, in spite of the fact that the resin of which the particles were made was denser than the suspending liquid. An explanation was forthcoming based on the recognition that the number of suspended Brownian particles per unit volume decreased with height. Given this, the random motions of the particles give rise to an upward pressure, because the number of particles striking a horizontal layer in the suspending liquid from below would be slightly greater than that striking it from above. Equilibrium is attained when the effect of this pressure acting upwards balances the weight of the particles acting downwards. Perrin was able to show experimentally that the density distribution of particles did indeed remain constant indefinitely once thermal equilibrium had been reached, after three hours or so.

质量为 m 的 n 个粒子以平均速度 v 撞击表面所产生的压力，是牛顿力学中一个简单的计算题。粒子撞击表面引起的单位时间内动量的变化，可以用 Perrin 运用统计方法计算出来。这些统计方法在詹姆斯·克拉克·麦克斯韦将其引入气体分子运动论之后，已沿用了近半个世纪。将这种压力产生的向上力设为粒子向下作用的重力，即可得到以下方程：

The pressure exerted by n particles of mass, m, striking a surface with average velocity, v, is a straightforward exercise in Newtonian mechanics. The change in momentum per unit time brought about by particles striking a surface could be calculated by Perrin employing statistical techniques common for almost half a century following James Clerk Maxwell’s introduction of them in the context of the kinetic theory of gases. Setting the upwards force due to this pressure equal to the weight of the particles acting downwards yields the following equation:

这里 n 0 /n 表示相距 h 的两个高度处单位体积粒子数的比值，∆ 表示布朗粒子材料密度与它们悬浮的液体密度之比，r 是它们的半径，g 是重力加速度，W 是粒子的平均动能，即 (1/2)mv 2的平均值。

Here n0 /n represents the ratio of the number of particles per unit volume at two heights separated by a distance, h, ∆ represents the excess of the density of the material of the Brownian particles over that of the liquid in which they are suspended, r is their radius, g is the acceleration due to gravity and W is the mean kinetic energy of the particles, that is, the mean value of (1/2)mv2.

该方程表明 n 随高度呈指数变化。佩兰通过实验证明了这一点。此外，由于佩兰能够以下文将要讨论的方式测量上述方程中除 W 以外的所有量，因此他可以计算出 W。也就是说，佩兰能够确定布朗粒子的平均动能。一系列改变粒子大小、材料和悬浮液性质的实验表明，粒子的平均动能与所有这些因素无关，仅取决于实验进行的绝对温度 T。

The equation shows n varying exponentially with height. Perrin was able to show experimentally that this was indeed the case. Further, since, in ways that are discussed below, Perrin was able to measure all the quantities in the above equation other than W, he could calculate the latter quantity. That is, Perrin was able to determine the mean value of the kinetic energy of Brownian particles. Series of experiments that varied the size and material of the particles and the nature of the suspending liquid revealed that the mean kinetic energy of the particles was independent of all these factors and depended only on the absolute temperature, T, at which the experiments were conducted.

以上讨论仅涉及佩兰基于牛顿力学假设对布朗运动的观察所得出的结论，并未涉及气体分子运动论。然而，一旦假设布朗运动是由粒子与悬浮液体分子碰撞时所受到的冲击的统计波动引起的（正如分子运动论所假设的那样），那么佩兰的发现便能得到合理的解释。运动本身的总体特征需要进一步解释。这里需要认识到，布朗粒子之间很少发生碰撞。那么，它们运动方向频繁变化的原因是什么呢？粒子与悬浮液体随机分子运动的碰撞给出了答案。分子运动论的一个基本假设是，系统的温度是其分子运动平均动能的量度。热接触系统最终达到相同温度，从分子运动论的角度来看，这意味着它们分子运动的平均动能趋于相等。将这一假设应用于布朗运动，一旦达到热平衡，布朗粒子的平均动能将等于与其碰撞的分子的平均动能。也就是说，一旦温度固定，粒子的平均动能也将固定。这便能直接解释佩兰的实验发现：他测得的平均动能与粒子的大小、材料以及悬浮液的性质无关。佩兰测定的布朗运动的许多定量特征，一旦运用动力学理论，便能得到直接而明确的解释，否则则难以理解。

The above discussion involves only what Perrin could establish on the basis of observations of Brownian motions assuming Newtonian mechanics. No appeal to the kinetic theory of gases is involved. But once it is assumed that the Brownian motion is caused by statistical fluctuations in the impacts experienced by the particles as they collide with molecules of the suspending liquid, as assumed in the kinetic theory, then Perrin’s findings find a ready explanation. The broad features of the motion themselves require explanation. Here it needs to be realised that the Brownian particles rarely collide with each other. So what is the cause of the frequent changes in their direction of motion? Collisions of the particles with the random molecular motions of the suspending liquid supply the answer. It is a fundamental assumption of the kinetic theory that the temperature of a system is a measure of the mean kinetic energy of its underlying molecular motions. The fact that systems in thermal contact settle down to the same temperature means, from the point of view of the kinetic theory, that the mean kinetic energy of their molecular motions become equalised. Applying this assumption to Brownian motion, the mean kinetic energy of the Brownian particles will become equal to the mean kinetic energy of the molecules with which they collide once thermal equilibrium is reached. That is, the mean kinetic energy of the particles will be fixed once the temperature is fixed. We have an immediate explanation of Perrin’s experimental finding that the mean kinetic energies he measured were independent of the size and material of the particles and the nature of the suspending fluid. Many quantitative features of Brownian motion as determined by Perrin have an immediate and straightforward explanation once we appeal to the kinetic theory but are mysterious otherwise.

这里涉及的“巧合论证”绝非佩兰通过实验所证实的分子及其运动的全部证据。我们已经看到，他是如何测量布朗粒子在特定绝对温度T下的平均动能的。分子运动论的基本原理是，在温度T下，任何系统中所有粒子的平均动能都相同。通过测量布朗粒子的平均动能，佩兰不仅测量了导致其运动的分子运动的平均动能，而且还测量了温度T下任何系统中所有分子运动的平均动能。具体来说，他实际上测量了温度T下气体分子的平均动能。这一知识使得我们可以用一种直接的方法（此处不再赘述）计算出所谓的阿伏伽德罗常数，即任何气体每克分子中所含的分子数。该值与通过完全不同的方法得出的值非常吻合，这一事实进一步加强了佩兰的“巧合论证”。

The ‘argument from coincidence’ involved here by no means exhausts the case for molecules and their motions that Perrin was able to support by experiment. We have seen how he was able to measure the mean kinetic energy of Brownian particles at some absolute temperature, T. Fundamental to the kinetic theory is that the mean kinetic energy of the particles composing any system at temperature, T, will have the same mean kinetic energy. By measuring the mean kinetic energy of Brownian particles Perrin had not only measured the mean kinetic energy of the molecular motions responsible for their motion, he had measured the mean kinetic energy of the molecular motions of any system at temperature, T. In particular, he had in effect measured the mean kinetic energy of the molecules of a gas at temperature, T. This knowledge made it possible, in a straightforward way that I will not rehearse here, to calculate what is known as Avogadro’s number, the number of molecules in a gram molecule of any gas. The fact that that value agreed well with values for the number arrived at by quite different methods further strengthened Perrin’s ‘argument from coincidence’.

还有更多发现。正如爱因斯坦在1905年所证明的，分子运动是布朗运动成因的假设，对粒子随时间的平均位移和平均旋转具有重要意义。动力学理论表明，这两个量都应与时间的平方根成正比。佩兰通过实验证明了这一点。此外，对平均位移和平均旋转的测量还为佩兰提供了两种测量粒子（进而测量给定温度下气体分子）平均动能的方法。这反过来又为他提供了两种计算阿伏伽德罗常数的方法。结果与之前的结果吻合良好。

There was yet more to come. The assumption that molecular motions are the cause of Brownian motion has implications for the mean displacement and mean rotation of the particles over time, as Einstein had shown in 1905. The kinetic theory implies that both of these quantities should be proportional to the square root of time elapsed. Perrin was able to show experimentally that this was indeed the case. What is more, measurements of the mean displacement and mean rotation gave Perrin two further ways of measuring the mean kinetic energy of the particles and hence of the molecules of a gas at a given temperature. This, in turn, gave him two further ways of calculating Avogadro’s number. The results were in good agreement with the previous ones.

到目前为止，我的讨论一直假设佩兰能够测量诸如布朗粒子的半径之类的物理量，并比较不同高度下单位体积内的粒子数量。仔细研究佩兰测量的一些细节，可以让我们更深入地理解观测结果对理论的依赖性以及独立检验的重要性。例如，佩兰是如何确定布朗粒子的半径（即上式中的“r”）的。

So far in my discussion I have simply assumed that Perrin could measure quantities such as the radius of Brownian particles and compare the number of particles per unit volume at different heights. Looking at some of the details of Perrin’s measurements reveals important insights into the notions of theory-dependence of observation and the importance of independent tests. I take, as an example, the procedures by which Perrin established the radius of the Brownian particles, represented by ‘r’ in the above equation.

提及粒子半径意味着所有粒子的半径都相同。佩兰花了长达三个月的时间才制备出含有大小大致相同的粒子的乳液。他为此使用了当时最先进的离心机。测量粒子的大小并非易事。这些粒子太小，无法用移动显微镜直接测量。在他的第一篇论文中，佩兰描述了他如何通过测量粒子云在已知粘度液体中的下落速度，并利用斯托克斯定律计算粒子半径来估算粒子的大小。斯托克斯定律描述了球体在粘性介质中运动时所受到的阻力与其速度之间的关系。佩兰的理论遭到了批评，批评者指出，斯托克斯定律尚未被实验证实适用于像布朗粒子这样小的粒子，而且该定律的理论推导假设粘性力在球体表面连续变化，这从动力学理论的角度来看显然是一个有问题的假设！佩兰随后设计了另外两种测量粒子半径的方法。在容器壁附近，布朗粒子倾向于聚集形成团块。佩兰在这些团块中寻找排列整齐的粒子。例如，他利用一台移动显微镜测量了五个排列整齐的粒子的长度，从而估算出每个粒子的半径。对其他排列整齐的粒子重复测量，得到的半径值也相似，这直接证明了粒子的尺寸确实均匀。佩兰还通过称量包含一定数量粒子的体积，并利用粒子材料的密度（他也可以用几种独立的方法测量）来计算粒子的半径，以此估算粒子的尺寸。除了那些运用斯托克斯定律的方法外，这些测量方法在任何有意义的意义上都不能说是依赖于理论的。此外，佩兰只接受几个独立测量结果相互一致的数值。佩兰还以类似的方式（此处不再赘述）来支持他对构成布朗粒子的材料密度、不同高度单位体积内粒子数量的比较以及粒子的平均位移和平均旋转的测量结果。

Reference to the radius of particles implies that they all have the same radius. It took Perrin up to three months to prepare emulsions containing particles of approximately equal size. He used a state-of-the-art centrifuge to do so. Measuring the size of particles was no straightforward matter. They were too small to be measured directly by a travelling microscope. In his first publication Perrin described how he estimated the size of particles by measuring the speed of fall of a cloud of particles through a liquid of known viscosity and calculating their radius using Stokes’ law that relates the resisting force experienced by a sphere moving through a viscous medium to its velocity. Perrin was taken to task by critics, who pointed out that Stokes’ law had not been experimentally confirmed for particles as small as Brownian particles, whilst the theoretical derivation of the law assumed that viscous forces vary continuously over the surface of the sphere, hardly an unproblematic assumption from the point of view of the kinetic theory! Perrin responded by devising two further methods of measuring the radius. Near the walls of the containing vessel the Brownian particles tended to coagulate in groups. Perrin looked amongst them for particles that were aligned. By measuring the length of, say, five aligned particles, which was possible with a travelling microscope, Perrin could estimate the radius of each. The fact that repetitions of the measurement for other aligned particles gave similar values for the radius gave Perrin direct evidence that the particles were indeed of uniform size. Perrin also estimated the size of particles by weighing a volume containing a countable number of them and calculating their radius using the density of the material of the particles, which he could also measure by several independent methods. With the exception of the ones that invoked Stokes’ law, none of these measurements can be said to be theory-dependent in any useful sense. What is more, Perrin accepted values only when the results of several independent measurements agreed with each other. In similar kinds of ways which I will not document here, Perrin supported his measurements of the density of the material of which the Brownian particles were composed, the comparative numbers of particles per unit volume at various heights and the mean displacement and mean rotation of particles.

佩兰的实验测量结果得到了充分的证实，其可靠性已达到人们所能合理要求的程度。此外，佩兰所检验的论断的推导过程也具有一些同样重要的意义，有助于理解他对动力学理论的论证本质。我们已经讨论过，在理论中添加辅助假设会引入这样一种可能性：这些假设本身的缺陷可能导致对理论优缺点的错误判断。佩兰论证的一个显著特点是，它仅需动力学理论的基本假设，而无需任何辅助假设。动力学理论的基本假设是分子运动的随机性和能量的均匀分布。佩兰通过多种方式证明布朗粒子的运动确实是随机的，从而为前者提供了新的支持。能量的均匀分布则需要进一步探讨。

Perrin’s experimental measurements were confirmed in as strong a sense as could reasonably be demanded. There are also some features of the derivation of the claims that Perrin put to the test that are of comparable importance for understanding the nature of his case for the kinetic theory. We have discussed how the addition of auxiliary assumptions to a theory introduces the possibility that imperfections in them can lead to false conclusions about the strengths and weaknesses of it. A striking feature of Perrin’s argument is that it required only the basic assumptions of the kinetic theory without the need for auxiliaries. Basic to the kinetic theory was the randomness attributed to molecular motions and the equi-distribution of energy. Perrin gave novel support to the first by showing in a number of ways that the motion of the Brownian particles is indeed random. The equi-distribution of energy requires some discussion.

动力学理论的一个基本假设是将温度等同于体系中分子的平均动能。处于相同温度下的所有体系的分子必须具有相同的平均动能。例如，如果氢气与氧气处于热平衡状态，则每种气体的分子平均动能必须相同。由于氧分子比氢分子重，因此它们的平均运动速度通常比氢分子慢。从动力学理论的角度来看，分子与它们碰撞的布朗粒子之间的唯一区别在于尺度，因此动能的均匀分布也必须适用于这些粒子。这就是佩兰在解释我们讨论过的布朗粒子密度分布细节时所涉及的假设，也是动力学理论中唯一相关的假设。

A basic assumption of the kinetic theory involves the identification of temperature with the mean kinetic energy of the molecules of a system. The molecules of all systems at the same temperature must possess the same mean kinetic energy. So, for example, if hydrogen gas is in thermal equilibrium with oxygen gas, the molecules of each gas must possess the same kinetic energy on average. Since oxygen molecules are heavier than hydrogen molecules they mostly, on average, move slower than the latter. Because, from the point of view of the kinetic theory, the only difference between molecules and Brownian particles with which they collide is one of scale, the equi-distribution of kinetic energy must apply to the particles too. This is the assumption, and the only assumption involving the kinetic theory, that was involved in Perrin’s explanation of details of the density distribution of Brownian particles that we have discussed.

从更广义的角度来看，分子运动论涉及能量的等分布。分子碰撞时会损失或获得动能，这并非简单地通过彼此之间的动能转移或获得，而是通过获得或损失转动能或振动能来实现。然而，如果温度要保持恒定，平均动能必须通过这种能量交换保持不变。平均而言，某些碰撞中损失的动能（转化为振动能或转动能）必须与另一些碰撞中获得的动能相平衡。其结果是平动能、转动能和振动能之间的能量等分布。只有在这一假设下，从分子运动论的角度来看，才能说一个系统具有确定的温度。平均平动能（动能）和平均转动能的相等性在佩兰对布朗粒子平均转动的研究中得到了体现。

There is a more general sense in which the kinetic theory involves equi-distribution of energy. When molecules collide they lose or gain kinetic energy, not simply by transferring kinetic energy to or gaining it from each other but by gaining or losing rotational or vibrational energy. Nevertheless, if temperature is to remain constant the mean kinetic energy must remain unchanged by such exchanges of energy. On average, the kinetic energy lost to vibrational or rotational energy on some collisions must be balanced by kinetic energy gained in others. The result is an equi-distribution of energy between translational, rotational and vibrational modes. It is only on this assumption that a system can be said to have a definite temperature from the point of view of the kinetic theory. The equality of mean translational (kinetic) energy and rotational energy was involved in Perrin’s investigation of the mean rotation of Brownian particles.

佩兰的观察结果得到了强有力的证实，而且他对动能理论的检验仅需该理论的一般假设，无需任何可能存在问题的辅助假设，这两点共同解释了他论证的有力性。让我以佩兰利用粒子密度分布计算阿伏伽德罗常数为例来说明这种情况。鉴于佩兰只接受那些被多种独立方法证实的测量结果，从某种意义上说，佩兰无法选择他需要输入方程的数值。这些数值是由自然界决定的，而非他自己决定的。布朗粒子的垂直分布呈指数分布，并且阿伏伽德罗常数可以由此计算得出，这一事实源于动能均匀分布这一动能理论的基本假设，无需其他任何假设。当佩兰测量布朗粒子在约十分之一毫米高度上的密度分布变化时，最终的测量结果是由自然界提供的。理论上，结果可能是在如此小的距离内没有检测到密度变化。如果真是如此，佩兰就会计算出阿伏伽德罗常数为零。也可能是布朗粒子经过足够长的时间后全部沉降到容器底部。如果真是如此，佩兰就会得出阿伏伽德罗常数为无穷大。可能性范围几乎不可能更大了。不难想象，佩兰（1990，第104页）为何会“激动万分”地得知，他实际测量得到的数值约为7 × 10²³ ，与之前不涉及布朗运动的阿伏伽德罗常数估计值接近。而这仅仅是佩兰为支持动力学理论而提出的“巧合论证”的一部分。

The extent to which Perrin’s observations were strongly confirmed and the fact that his tests of the kinetic theory required only the general assumptions of that theory with no need for potentially problematic auxiliaries together account for the strength of his argument. Let me dramatise the situation in the case of Perrin’s calculation of Avogadro’s number from the density distribution of particles. Given the extent to which Perrin accepted only those measurements that were borne out by a number of independent methods, there is a strong sense in which Perrin could not choose the numbers he needed to feed into his equations. They were determined by the world, not him. The fact that the vertical distribution of Brownian particles should be exponential and that Avogadro’s number could be calculated from it followed from the equi-distribution of kinetic energy basic to the kinetic theory and required no other assumptions. When Perrin measured the change in density distribution of Brownian particles over heights of around a tenth of a millimetre it was nature that delivered the resulting measurements. The result could conceivably have been that no variation in density was detected over such a small distance. Had this result eventuated Perrin would have calculated a value of zero for Avogadro’s number. It might have been that given sufficient time the Brownian particles all settled to the bottom of the container. Had this eventuated Perrin would have derived a value of infinity for Avogadro’s number. The range of possibilities could hardly have been larger. One can imagine why Perrin (1990, p. 104) greeted ‘with the liveliest emotion’ the fact that the number that his measurements actually led him to was around 7 × 1023, close to previous estimates of Avogadro’s number acquired by means not involving Brownian motion. And this was only part of the ‘argument from coincidence’ that Perrin was able to mount in favour of the kinetic theory.

佩兰对分子动力学理论的论证可谓无比有力，由此人们或许会倾向于认为，当代科学哲学中普遍存在的、本书也给予充分重视的关于科学知识易错性的论断是错误的。然而，这种想法是错误的。事实上，佩兰支持的分子动力学理论是错误的，而且已被证实是错误的。该理论的基本能量均匀分布假设，对气体的比热容有着直接的、与观测结果相悖的后果。正如佩兰本人后来所发现的，能量均匀分布假设在振动模式中失效，并且在足够低的温度下，在转动模式中也失效。只有量子力学才能解决这个问题。佩兰的实验之后，人们对物质的分子构成以及分子运动是布朗运动的成因几乎毫无疑问。但这远不足以完全证实分子动力学理论。

Perrin’s case for the kinetic theory could hardly have been stronger, and in the light of it one might be tempted to conclude that the insistence on the fallibility of scientific knowledge common in contemporary philosophy of science and given due credence in this book is misplaced. That would be a mistake. In fact, the kinetic theory supported by Perrin is false and known to be false. The equi-distribution of energy fundamental to the theory has straightforward consequences for the specific heats of gases that clash with observation. Equi-distribution breaks down for vibrational modes and, at low enough temperatures, for rotational modes as well, as Perrin himself became aware. It takes quantum mechanics to cope with the problem. After Perrin’s experiments there could be little doubt about the molecular constitution of matter and the identification of molecular motions as the cause of Brownian motion. But this falls short of confirmation of the kinetic theory in an unqualified sense.

理论的划分：十九世纪化学中的原子论

Partitioning of theories: atomism in nineteenth-century chemistry

对理论的实验支持并非总是像佩兰对动力学理论的支持那样令人信服，而且正如我们所指出的，即便实验支持有力，我们也需要谨慎对待究竟哪些内容得到了证实。佩兰证实了动力学理论的某些方面，但并非全部。这里有两个问题，约翰·道尔顿将原子引入化学的例子可以很好地说明这两个问题。第一个问题是认识到，基于巧合的论证的强度是一个程度问题。第二个问题是，需要尽可能地对理论进行划分，以便准确地确定特定实验论证证实了理论的哪些部分。

Experimental support for theories is not always as compelling as that made by Perrin for the kinetic theory and, as we have noted, even when it is, we need to be circumspect about just what it is that has been confirmed. Perrin confirmed some aspects of the kinetic theory but not all of it. There are two issues here, both of which can be usefully illustrated by reference to John Dalton’s introduction of atoms into chemistry. The first includes the recognition that the strength of arguments from coincidence is a matter of degree. The second is the need to partition theories where possible to help establish precisely which parts of them are confirmed by a particular experimental argument.

道尔顿于1808年发表了他的“新化学哲学体系”。他提出，每种化学元素都由原子构成，而化合物则由“复合原子”构成，这些复合原子又由组成它们的元素的原子组成。同一种元素的原子彼此相同，同一种化合物的复合原子也彼此相同。道尔顿的理论最有力的佐证在于它所蕴含的三条比例定律。恒比定律指出，化合物中各元素的质量比始终保持不变。（例如，水中氧与氢的质量比始终为8:1。）倍比定律指出，如果两种元素结合形成多种化合物，那么每种化合物中一种元素的质量与另一种元素的质量之比均为简单的整数。 （一氧化二氮、一氧化氮和过氧化氮中氮与氧的质量比为4:2:1。）倒数定律指出，如果两种元素A和B分别与元素C结合形成化合物，且A和B结合形成化合物的比例为x:y，那么与一定质量的元素C结合的A和B的相对质量比为nx:my，其中n和m为较小的整数。（氢和氧以1:8的比例结合形成水，它们都与氮结合形成氨和一氧化氮。在后两种化合物中，氢和氧相对于一定质量的氮的质量比为3:16，即3×1:2×8，符合倒数定律。）不难看出，这些定律可以直接从道尔顿的假设推导而来，即化合物的最小组成部分是由具有确定且不变质量的元素原子构成的。

Dalton published his ‘new system of chemical philosophy’ in 1808. In it he proposed that each chemical element is made up of atoms and that chemical compounds are made up of ‘compound atoms’ consisting of atoms of the elements composing them. Atoms of an element are all alike as are compound atoms of a given compound. Dalton’s theory can be put in its most favourable light by noting that it was borne out by three laws of proportion that it entailed. The law of constant proportions states that the relative proportions by weight of elements in their compounds are always the same. (The weight of oxygen to hydrogen in water is always eight to one.) The law of multiple proportions says that if two elements combine to form more than one compound then the weights of one element compared with a fixed weight of the other in each compound will be to each other as simple integral numbers. (The ratio of nitrogen per unit weight of oxygen in nitrous oxide, nitric oxide and nitrogen peroxide is as 4:2:1.) The law of reciprocal proportions states that if two elements A and B each combine with C to form compounds and if A and B combine to form a compound in the ratio x:y, then the relative weights of A and B that combine with a fixed weight of C will be as nx:my where n and m are small integral numbers. (Hydrogen and oxygen combine in the ratio 1:8 to form water, and both combine with nitrogen to form ammonia and nitric oxide. The weights of hydrogen and oxygen compared with a fixed weight of nitrogen in the latter compounds are as 3:16, which is 3x1 : 2x8, in accordance with the law.) It is not difficult to see how these laws can be seen as following straightforwardly from Dalton’s assumption that least parts of compounds are made up of atoms of the elements possessing a definitive and invariable weight.

道尔顿提出原子论时，反对的声音远大于支持的声音。这其中有很多原因。其中一个原因是，在道尔顿时代，乃至此后的几十年里，人们都无法根据当时掌握的数据确定化合物的原子构成。例如，实验测得的水中氧原子量与氢原子量之比为8，这与水分子H₂O和氧原子量与氢原子量之比为16，或者水分子HO和氧原子量与氢原子量之比为8，以及许多更复杂的组合方式都存在矛盾。一个更根本的原因是，道尔顿时代的化学研究并不关注他的原子论的真伪。简而言之，当时的化学家们关注的是物质之间的结合方式和结合程度，而道尔顿的原子论在这方面却无能为力。还应指出的是，我对道尔顿理论的阐述是一个精简版本，它从道尔顿原著的诸多细节中提炼出了由比例定律所体现的关键化学思想。例如，道尔顿假设原子周围环绕着球形的热云，他认为这会影响气体的比热容；他假设给定气体的原子之间存在相互排斥力，其大小与原子间距成反比；他还假设原子量与气体在液体中的溶解度之间存在简单的关系。这些假设最终都无济于事。道尔顿的原子理论在某种程度上得到了巧合论证的支持，因为它能够解释比例定律，但这种支持被将原子论扩展到比例定律之外的经验困难所抵消，而且该理论本身也无法为化学提供有效信息。这种情况最终通过将化学式引入化学并应用于有机化学而得到改变。

At the time he proposed it, Dalton’s atomic theory received more opposition than support. There was a range of reasons why this was so. One reason lay in the fact that definitive atomic constitution of compounds could not be arrived at given the data available at Dalton’s time, nor, indeed, for several decades thereafter. For instance, the experimentally determined fact that the weight of oxygen in water relative to hydrogen is eight is compatible with H2O for water and an atomic weight of sixteen for oxygen relative to hydrogen, with HO for water and a relative atomic weight of eight for oxygen and a host of more complicated possibilities. A more fundamental reason is that chemistry at Dalton’s time was not capable of being affected by the truth or otherwise of his atomic theory. Roughly speaking, chemists were interested in what combines with what and to what degree, and Dalton’s atomism had nothing to say on that score. It should also be noted that my account of Dalton’s theory is a cleaned-up version that abstracts the key chemical idea borne out by laws of proportion from much detail contained in Dalton’s own version. For instance, Dalton assumed his atoms were surrounded by spherical clouds of caloric which he saw as having consequences for the specific heats of gases, he assumed that atoms of a given gas repel each other with a force inversely proportional to their separation and he assumed a simple relationship between atomic weights and the solubility of gases in liquids. These assumptions went nowhere. Dalton’s atomic theory was supported to some degree by an argument from coincidence insofar as it could account for the three laws of proportion, but this fact was offset by the empirical difficulties associated with the extension of atomism beyond laws of proportion and the fact that the theory did not have the capacity to inform chemistry. The situation was to be transformed via the introduction of formulae into chemistry and their application to organic chemistry.

我在上一段中使用水的化学式并非道尔顿本人的做法。他用球体排列图来表示原子组合，而非使用化学式。化学式最早由瑞典化学家雅各布·贝采利乌斯于1813年引入化学领域。对于我关于理论验证的论述而言，必须认识到使用化学式与坚持原子论并非同一概念。事实上，贝采利乌斯引入化学式是为了捕捉他认为道尔顿创新中最重要的部分——比例定律的发现，而并非坚持原子论，他认为原子论虽然有趣，但却存在问题。化学式中的符号，例如水的H₂O，可以被解释为指代原子，而这正是我们今天所默认的。基于这种解释，水的化学式以及结合重量的测量结果表明，一个氧原子的质量是氢原子的十六倍。但化学式中的符号还有另一种解释，这种解释更符合十九世纪化学家在实验室中的实际操作。虽然氢原子可以作为估算相对原子量的单位，但这并非必要。任何一部分氢都可以作为参考原子量。如果采用这种方法，那么相应部分的氧的质量将是参考氢的十六倍。化学式中的符号可以解释为表示部分而非原子，这足以涵盖十九世纪化学家所掌握并用比例定律概括的所有关于组合质量的细节。贝采利式在引入后的几十年里并没有得到广泛应用，这一点很容易理解，因为人们认识到它们可以被解释为一种概括组合比例的工具，而这些比例可以用其他方式表达。道尔顿反对使用原子论，或许是因为他意识到原子论提供了一种表达他对比例组合的见解的方式，从而避免了他所信奉的原子论。

My use of formulae for water in the previous paragraph was not Dalton’s own practice. He employed diagrams of arrangements of spheres to illustrate atomic combinations rather than formulae. The latter were first introduced into chemistry by the Swedish chemist Jacob Berzelius in 1813. It is important for my story about theory-confirmation to recognise that use of formulae and a commitment to atomism are not the same thing. As a matter of historical fact Berzelius introduced formulae as a device to capture what he saw as important about Dalton’s innovation, namely, recognition of laws of proportion, without a commitment to atomism which he regarded as an interesting but problematic assumption. The symbols in a chemical formula, such as H2O for water, can be interpreted as referring to atoms, and that is what is automatically assumed today. Given that interpretation, the formula for water together with measurements of combining weights imply that an atom of oxygen weighs sixteen times more than an atom of hydrogen. But there is another interpretation of the symbols in formulae that is more in keeping with what nineteenth-century chemists did in their laboratories. While an atom of hydrogen can be taken as the unit against which relative atomic weights are estimated, that is not necessary. Any portion of hydrogen whatsoever can be taken as supplying the reference weight. If that is done then the corresponding portion of oxygen will be one that is sixteen times heavier than the reference sample of hydrogen. The symbols in chemical formulae can be interpreted as referring to portions rather than atoms and this is sufficient to capture all the details about combining weights that the nineteenth-century chemists had access to and summarised with laws of proportion. Berzelian formulae were not much used in the couple of decades following their introduction, and this can be readily understood once it is recognised that they can be interpreted as a device for summarising facts about combining proportions that can be expressed in other ways. Dalton’s opposition to their use perhaps stemmed from the fact that he recognised that they provided a way of representing his insights about combining proportions that avoided the commitment to atoms that he espoused.

自19世纪20年代末以来，化学式在有机化学领域的应用彻底改变了其地位。化学式在该领域的成功应用源于其能够表达超越比例定律的化学组合事实。在此之前，人们或许会认为选择不同的化学式是约定俗成的。按照这种观点，只要氧的相对原子量也选择8，就可以选择HO来表示水。没有任何事实表明HO是错误的化学式，而H₂O才是正确的。然而，有机化学的发展逐渐动摇了这种约定俗成的观点。到1860年左右，有机化学家们已经找到了他们认为正确的化学式。这背后的故事错综复杂，我仅举一个例子来说明。考虑到可测量的配比重量以及现代相对原子量值，乙酸的最简式为CH₂O 。然而，这个式子无法反映这样一个事实：乙酸中的氢可以在实验室中以四种不同的方式被等体积的氯取代，其中三种方式会生成与乙酸性质相似的酸，而第四种方式则会生成盐。为了解决这个问题，可以将式子中的原子数加倍，并将其中一个氢原子与其他三个氢原子分开，得到C₂H₃O₂H 。现在，我们可以将这三种酸视为分别由氯取代三个氢原子（它们聚集在一起）中的一个或多个所致，而盐则是由氯取代唯一一个氢原子（现在已确定该氢原子是乙酸酸性的来源）所致。到1860年左右，针对我所描述的这类化学式，已经出现了一套独特的化学式能够胜任这项任务。化学家们追求的是正确的配方，而不仅仅是有用的配方，传统主义的立场因此受到动摇。

The status of chemical formulae was transformed once they were employed to bring order into organic chemistry from the late 1820s. Their successful application in that area stemmed from the fact that they were used to express facts about chemical combination that went beyond laws of proportion. Prior to that success the choice between competing chemical formulae could plausibly be interpreted as conventional. On this view one can choose HO for water as long as one also chooses eight for the relative atomic weight of oxygen. There is no fact of the matter that makes this the wrong choice of formula and H2O the right one. Developments in organic chemistry were to undermine the conventionalist position. By around 1860 organic chemists had arrived at formulae that they could argue to be the correct ones. The detailed story is a rich and complicated one. I illustrate with just one example. The simplest formula for acetic acid, given combining weights that can be measured and using modern values for relative atomic weights, is CH2O. This formula cannot be used to reflect the fact that the hydrogen in acetic acid can be replaced in the laboratory by an equal volume of chlorine in four different ways, three of them yielding acids similar to acetic acid and a fourth yielding a salt. The situation can be handled by doubling the numbers in the formula and separating one of the hydrogens from the other three, resulting in C2H3O2H. The three acids can now be seen as resulting from the replacement by chlorine of one, two or all three of the hydrogens grouped together and the salt resulting from replacement of the lone hydrogen, now identified as responsible for the acidic character of acetic acid, by chlorine. The demands put on formulae of the kind I have illustrated had, by around 1860, yielded a unique set of them up to the task. Chemists sought the right formulae, not just useful ones, and the conventionalist position was undermined.

在我讨论理论证实问题时，必须认识到，尽管有机化学的这些进展解决了关于化学式是否为惯例的争论，但并未解决正确化学式中的符号代表的是原子还是原子团的问题。我们可以将十九世纪晚期的化学进行划分，将关于原子的假设与其余部分分开，正如我们所见，这并不意味着要从其余部分中移除化学式。如果我的论断正确，即十九世纪化学家能够用来支持其理论的所有证据都可以被那些将原子部分分离出来的理论所处理，那么就不能说原子论得到了证实。

It is important for my discussion of theory-confirmation to recognise that whilst these moves in organic chemistry settled the debate over whether formulae were conventional or not, it did not settle the issue of whether the symbols in the correct formulae represent atoms or portions. We can take chemistry of the late nineteenth century and partition it so that assumptions concerning atoms are separated from the remainder, which, as we have seen, does not require the removal of chemical formulae from that remainder. If I am right to claim that all the evidence that could be brought to bear on their theories by nineteenth-century chemists can be handled by those theories with atoms partitioned off, then it cannot be said that atomism was confirmed.

我关于十九世纪化学中的原子论缺乏充分论证且原则上是多余的论断颇具争议。大多数当代科学家和哲学家并不认同这一观点。十九世纪化学家自身的态度则更为复杂。皮埃尔·杜昂（2002）在十九世纪之交曾提出过与我非常相似的观点，但他的观点并非主流。如今，他往往被视为误入歧途的实证主义者，但就化学领域而言，这种看法是错误的。十九世纪的化学家虽然认可原子论，但他们对将原子等同于机械哲学或动力学理论中所假定的原子持谨慎态度。他们认识到，赋予原子足以解释其在化学中作用的性质是存在问题的，需要通过研究而非哲学论断来解决。例如，大约在 1860 年之后，人们逐渐认识到原子需要具有化合价，而这一特性给当时的机制和物理学带来了问题，而不是由此而来。

My claim that atomism in nineteenth-century chemistry was not well confirmed and was in principle redundant is controversial. It is not endorsed by the majority of contemporary scientists and philosophers. The attitude of nineteenth-century chemists themselves is more complicated. A position very similar to mine was argued by Pierre Duhem (2002) at the turn of the nineteenth century but his view was not the common one. He tends to be dismissed as a misguided positivist these days, but mistakenly as far as the situation in chemistry is concerned. Insofar as nineteenth-century chemists endorsed atomism, they were wary of identifying atoms with those assumed in the mechanical philosophy or the kinetic theory. They recognised that attributing properties to atoms sufficient to account for their role in chemistry was problematic and an issue that needed to be settled by research rather than philosophical decree. For instance, after around 1860 it became clear that atoms need to possess valency, and this property posed problems for, rather than followed from, mechanism and the physics of the time.

尽管我和杜亨都对19世纪化学中原子理论的地位有所保留，但原子化学最终当然还是得到了实验的证实，而且识别化学和物理学中假定的原子和分子也变得可能且必要。我们在前一节中已经描述了佩兰关于布朗运动的实验如何足以消除人们对分子存在的严重怀疑，而通过动力学理论计算出的原子量和分子量与化学家得到的结果相吻合，这只是20世纪化学中原子论得到证实的众多方式之一。但值得注意的是，在物理学和化学领域，很快就必须赋予原子量子力学性质，而这些性质与19世纪化学家或物理学家的预期截然不同。

My, and Duhem’s, reservations about the status of atomic theory in nineteenth-century chemistry notwithstanding, atomic chemistry was eventually confirmed experimentally, of course, and it did become possible and necessary to identify the atoms and molecules assumed in chemistry and physics. We have described in the previous section how Perrin’s experiments on Brownian motion were sufficient to remove serious doubt about the existence of molecules, and the fact that the atomic and molecular weights that could be calculated via the kinetic theory coincided with those arrived at by chemists was just one of the increasing number of ways in which atomism in chemistry was confirmed in the twentieth century. But it is significant that it soon became necessary, in physics and chemistry, to attribute quantum mechanical properties to atoms that differed from anything anticipated by nineteenth-century chemists or physicists.

我之所以讨论十九世纪化学中原子论的地位，主要是为了说明在可能的情况下对理论进行划分的重要性，以便确定哪些划分部分可以被具体的实验所证实。但这里还可以提出另一个关于科学本质和地位的普遍观点。在当代科学中，人们普遍认为物质世界的深层结构与我们日常经验的世界截然不同，其特征与我们许多常见的直觉相悖。亚原子粒子拥有诸如粲和宇称等性质，而这些性质在我们的宏观经验世界中并不存在，它们在基础粒子物理学中是不可或缺的；而相对论学者则引入多维空间并否定绝对同时性。世界的深层结构与我们日常生活中习以为常的假设之间存在多大的冲突，这是需要我们去了解的。十七世纪的机械哲学家们在其物质理论中明确地纳入了微观世界与宏观世界在关键方面相似的假设，以便将宏观世界的知识投射到微观世界。他们眼中的原子如同台球一般，行为也与之类似。如今我们已深知他们错得多么离谱。就对物质世界的认知而言，科学与哲学家们传统实践的形而上学截然不同，两者之间几乎没有任何关联。在这方面，十九、二十世纪实证主义者的直觉方向是正确的，即便他们在阐述这些直觉时显得有些混乱。

I have discussed the status of atomism in nineteenth-century chemistry mainly to illustrate the importance of the need to partition theories, where possible, in order to determine which of the partitioned parts can be said to be confirmed by specific experiments. But there is another general point about the nature and status of science that can usefully be raised here. In contemporary science it is taken for granted that the deep structure of the material world is very different from the world of everyday experience and features of it clash with many of our common intuitions. Sub-atomic particles possessing properties such as charm and parity that have no correlates in the macroscopic world of our experience are indispensable in fundamental particle physics while relativity theorists invoke multi-dimensional spaces and reject absolute simultaneity. The extent to which the deep structure of the world clashes with assumptions that serve us well in our everyday dealings with it was something that needed to be learnt. The seventeenth-century mechanical philosophers explicitly incorporated into their matter theories the assumption that the micro-world is like the macro-world in crucial respects so that knowledge of the latter can be projected onto the former. Their atoms were akin to and behaved like billiard balls. We now know how wrong they were. As far as knowledge of the material world is concerned, science is categorically distinct from the kind of metaphysics traditionally practised by philosophers and owes little to it. On this score, the intuitions of the positivists of the nineteenth and twentieth centuries were on the right track, even if they did make a mess of articulating them.

现实主义与反现实主义之争

Realism versus anti-realism again

在关于科学的实在论与反实在论之争中，哲学文献出现了一些新的进展，促使我重新审视这个问题。其中一项进展是，例如Ladyman和Ross（2007）对John Worrall（1989b）所称的“结构实在论”进行了进一步阐述。结构实在论对实在论的修正，是对反对实在论的最有力论据的回应，这些论据援引了历史上一些成功理论被推翻的实例。实在论的一个关键论据是，涉及原子和电子等不可观测实体的科学理论取得了成功。如果这些理论所援引的实体（例如原子和电子）并不存在，也不具备理论所描述的属性，那么这些理论能够成功解释一系列现象并导致新现象的发现，就只能算作一个奇迹或一个惊人的巧合。反实在论者回应说，过去的一些理论取得了成功，其中包括对现象的新颖解释，而这些解释假设了一些现代科学认为并不存在的存在实体。热质理论和将光归因于物质以太中的波的理论的成功，便是此类理论最有力的例证。结构实在论者承认这种论点的说服力，并认为科学不应被理解为提供或朝着正确描述构成世界的不可观测实体及其属性的方向发展。相反，科学理论应被视为识别可观测现象背后的现实结构。在这种观点下，菲涅耳光理论中的波动方程是对光结构真实描述的良好近似，即使不存在作为波载体的以太。菲涅耳方程是电磁光理论的极限情况，这一事实也支持了上述观点。菲涅耳的理论之所以成功，是因为他赋予了光波动性，这一点是正确的；但他暗示了物质以太的存在，这一点是错误的。

There have been developments in the philosophical literature in the debate between realists and anti-realists with respect to science that motivate me to look at the issue afresh. One of those developments has been further articulation, for example by Ladyman and Ross (2007), of what John Worrall (1989b) called ‘structural realism’. The modification of realism involved in structural realism arises as a response to the strongest of the arguments against realism that invoke historically documented examples of the overthrow of previously successful theories. A key argument for realism appeals to the success of scientific theories involving unobservable entities such as atoms and electrons. The fact that such theories can successfully explain a range of phenomena and lead to the discovery of new phenomena would amount to a miracle or a remarkable coincidence if the entities, such as electrons and atoms, invoked by those theories did not exist and possess the properties attributed to them by the theories. The anti-realists respond by pointing to past theories, whose success included the novel explanations of phenomena, which posited entities that do not exist according to modern science. The success of the caloric theory and the theory that attributed light to waves in a material ether are the strongest examples of this kind. Structural realists admit the force of this argument and concede that science is not to be understood as providing or moving towards a correct description of the unobservable entities composing the world and the properties they possess. Rather, scientific theories are to be seen as identifying the structure of reality underlying observable phenomena. On this view, the wave equations involved in Fresnel’s theory of light are good approximations to a true description of the structure of light even though there is no ether serving as the seat of the waves. This position is supported by the fact that Fresnel’s equations follow as limiting cases of the electromagnetic theory of light. Fresnel was right insofar as the success of his theory stemmed from the attribution of a wave structure to light but wrong insofar as he implied the existence of a material ether.

基于下文将要探讨的原因，我认为结构实在论并非应对反实在论的正确方法。在某些方面，结构实在论的拥护者高估了反实在论援引科学史中理论变革实例的力量。在另一方面，我认为他们未能认识到反实在论在某些方面是正确的。我的立场基于科学中强烈的证实性、实在论者所假定的符合论的精确含义，以及复合体与构成它们的实体同样真实这一观点。以下三个小节将依次讨论这些问题。

For reasons that I explore below, I do not believe that structural realism is the correct response to the anti-realist case. In some respects its advocates overestimate the force of the anti-realist appeal to examples of theory change exhibited in the history of science. In another sense I believe that they fail to recognise a sense in which the anti-realist case is correct. My position draws on the strong sense of confirmation at work in science, the precise import of the correspondence theory of truth assumed by realists and the sense in which composites are no less real than the entities that compose them. These issues are discussed in turn in the following three subsections.

已被充分证实的理论永远不会被彻底否定。

Strongly confirmed theories are never completely discarded

在本后记的第一部分，我总结了一些要求极高的证实标准。我认为，如果我们认真对待这些严格的要求，那么我们就有能力挑战基于科学史的现实主义论点。拉里·劳丹（Larry Laudan，1981）基于历史例证对现实主义者提出的颇具影响力的挑战就是一个典型的例子。劳丹认为，过去的科学充斥着各种理论，这些理论在当时都取得了成功，但却援引了诸如晶体球、电流体、光粒子等等并不存在的事物。他支持所谓的悲观归纳法。正如过去科学中涉及的实体从现代科学的角度来看几乎都与现实无关一样，当代科学中涉及的实体从未来科学的角度来看也几乎都与现实无关。我的回应如下：劳丹引用的许多理论从未得到证实，或者只是得到了非常微弱的证实，而我所论证的这种强证实已经成为科学的显著特征。在某些情况下，即使已证实的理论最终被新的理论所取代，经过修正的理论版本仍然作为其后继理论的极限案例而存在。这些曾经成功但现在已被取代的理论，正如它们所代表的现有理论一样，也指向某种真实存在的事物。

In the first section of this Postscript I summarised standards of confirmation that are very demanding. I contend that if we take these strong demands seriously, then we are in a good position to challenge the case against realism based on the history of science. The influential challenge to realists based on historical examples launched by Larry Laudan (1981) is a case in point. According to Laudan, past science is replete with theories, successful in their time, invoking such non-existent things as crystalline spheres, electrical fluids. light corpuscles and the like. He supports the so-called pessimistic induction. Just as few of the entities involved in past science refer to anything real from the standpoint of modern science, so few of the entities of contemporary science will be considered as referring to anything real from the point of view of future science. I respond as follows. Many of the theories invoked by Laudan never were confirmed, or were only very weakly confirmed, in the strong sense that I have argued has become distinctive of science. In those cases where confirmation was strong but the confirmed theories superseded nevertheless, tidied-up versions of the superseded theories lived on as limiting cases of their successors. The previously successful but now superseded theories did refer to something real insofar as the current theories of which they are limiting cases do.

最接近反实在论论点的例子是十九世纪物理学中以太的命运。正如我们所见，正是这个例子促使沃勒尔提出了结构实在论。菲涅耳的光波动理论无疑得到了强有力的证实。然而，我关于分割的论述使人们对这种证实是否等同于机械以太的存在产生了怀疑。那些有力地支持菲涅耳理论的预测仅仅要求光是横波，而不是以太中的波。机械以太存在的证据需要超越证明光的波动性的证据，而正是由于未能找到这样的证据，才导致以太最终被物理学所抛弃。

The example that comes closest to supporting the anti-realist case involves the fate of the ether in nineteenth-century physics. As we have seen, it was mainly this example that led Worrall to formulate structural realism. There is no doubting that Fresnel’s wave theory of light was strongly confirmed. However, my remarks about partitioning cast doubt on the claim that this confirmation extended to confirmation of the existence of a mechanical ether. The predictions that so strongly supported Fresnel’s theory required only that light be a transverse wave, not that it be a wave in the ether. Evidence for a mechanical ether required evidence that went beyond establishing the wave character of light and it was in part the failure to produce such evidence that led to the ether being dropped from physics.

对我的观点，一个很自然的反对意见是，它带有后见之明的色彩。某种程度上的确如此。在十九世纪中期，人们自然而然地会认为波必然存在于某种介质之中。此外，横波的存在还要求这种介质具有弹性。而电磁波本身是由波动场构成，而非任何物质的状态，这一概念在当时还未出现。但我认为这并不构成对实在论的挑战。实在论认为，科学的目标是在可观测和不可观测的层面上描述世界，这意味着关于世界的论断可能是错误的。科学家无法直接获得真理，所有科学都将永远处于修正和改进之中。

A natural objection to my position here is the observation that it involves hindsight. There is certainly a sense in which it does. It was a natural assumption to make in the mid-nineteenth century that a wave must be a wave in something. What is more, transverse waves required that that something be elastic. The conception of electromagnetic waves consisting of fluctuating fields in themselves that are not states of anything lay in the future. But this does not strike me as constituting a problem for realism. The realist idea that it is the aim of science to characterise the world at both the observational and unobservational level implies that claims about it can be false. Scientists have no direct access to the truth and all science will be forever subject to modification and improvement.

佩兰提出的分子论证和菲涅耳提出的光波论证都如此有力，以至于认为未来的科学会证明它们并不存在是完全不可能的。这并非否认在佩兰时代，以及在菲涅耳时代，人们对​​原子和光的了解仍然非常有限。对于可观测的世界，也可以提出类似的观点。我们的感官并不完美，基于感官的论断也可能出错。然而，关于可观测物体的论断可以通过其经受独立检验的程度来证实。如果我们怀疑看到的匕首只是幻觉，我们可以触摸它。我们产生视觉幻觉的条件与产生触觉幻觉的条件截然不同，因此，如果两组条件同时出现，导致我们既看到又摸到匕首（而实际上并没有匕首），那将是一个极其巧合的现象。我认为，关键在于巧合论证的形式，无论论证的对象是可观察的还是不可观察的，形式都是一样的。不同之处在于，对于可观察的事物，我们可以直接通过感官进行独立检验；而对于不可观察的事物，情况则并非如此。这种比较还可以进一步展开。人们很容易对感官证据进行过度解读。例如，有些人认为火是一种非常轻的物质，由于其轻盈的性质而升腾到空中，我们很容易理解他们的想法。“火会上升”就成了通过观察确立的关于这种物质的真理。最终人们认识到，火这种物质并不存在。但这并不意味着火焰不存在。考虑到存在火焰的证据如此之多，怎么可能不存在呢？我认为，拒绝以太和保留光波的情况是类似的，而且，就其相似性而言，理论物理学所援引的实体的现实性与可观测物体的现实性是相等的。

The arguments for molecules mounted by Perrin and for light waves mounted by Fresnel were so strong that it is entirely implausible to suppose that some future science will show that there are no such things. This is not to deny that there remained much to be learnt about atoms at the time of Perrin and light at the time of Fresnel. An analogous range of points can be made with respect to the observable world. Our senses are imperfect and claims supported by them are fallible. Nevertheless, claims about observable objects can be substantiated by the extent to which they survive independent tests. If we suspect that the visible dagger is an illusion we can touch it. The conditions under which we are liable to have visual illusions are quite different from the conditions that lead to tactile illusions so it would be a remarkable coincidence if two sets of conditions should coincide to yield simultaneously the sighting and feel of a dagger when there is no dagger present. I suggest that the form of the argument from coincidence is what is important here, and is the same whether it is claims about the observable or the unobservable that is at issue. What is different is that in the case of the observable, independent tests are straightforwardly available through use of the senses whereas this is not the case for the unobservable. The comparison can be taken a stage further. It is quite possible to read into the evidence of the senses more than is warranted. It is not difficult to sympathise with those that supposed that fire is a very light substance that rises into the air by virtue of its lightness. ‘Fire rises’ is then a truth about this substance established by observation. It was eventually appreciated that there is no fire substance. But this does not mean that there is no such thing as flames. How could there not be given the range of evidence for them? I suggest that the situation involving the rejection of the ether and the retention of light waves is analogous, and, insofar as it is, the reality of the entities invoked by theoretical physics is on a par with that of observable objects.

我们所拥有的只有近似的真相。

Approximate truth is all we have

以下这种概括我在前一小节中阐述的大部分观点的方式颇具吸引力。由此可见，那些已被充分证实的理论是近似正确的，而当它们被更接近真理的理论所取代时，科学便得以进步。过去我一直避免以这种方式阐述我的观点，因为我意识到它面临着一个棘手的反对意见，这个反对意见源于如何精确理解“近似真理”的概念。反对意见认为，哲学家能够对真理做出精确的解释，即真理与事实的符合性，但这却无法与对近似真理的相应解释相匹配。现在，我倾向于通过质疑这一反对意见所依据的前提来回应它。尽管哲学家们能够基于塔尔斯基的洞见，对真理做出高度形式化的解释，但他们并没有因此改变真理符合论作为一种粗略且易于理解的概念的本质。我们对真理只有粗略的概念，或者说真理只有一定程度的概念，但这足以理解常识和科学，并支持对这两个领域的现实主义解释。

The following way of summarising a substantial part of the position I have outlined in the previous subsection has some appeal. Theories that are well confirmed are thereby shown to be approximately true and science progresses when they are replaced by theories that are better approximations to the truth. In the past I have refrained from formulating my position in this way because I have been aware of a challenging objection to it that stems from the problem of making precise sense of the notion of ‘approximate truth’. Philosophers are able to give a precise account of truth as correspondence to the facts, so the objection goes, which is not matched by a corresponding account of what approximate truth amounts to. I am now inclined to meet this objection by challenging the premise on which it is based. While philosophers have been able to give a highly formal account of truth building on Tarski’s insights they have not thereby altered the sense in which the correspondence theory of truth is a rough and ready conception. We only have a rough and ready notion of truth, or truth up to a point, but it is sufficient to make sense of commonsense and science and to support a realist interpretation of both areas of discourse.

我在第十五章简要介绍了塔尔斯基关于真理符合论的论述。塔尔斯基证明，在给定一种相对简单的语言谓词满足性概念的前提下，该语言中命题的真值可以用形式化的方式加以阐释，从而避免通常与真理概念相关的难题。正如我们所见，他的成功源于他对被分析真理主张的语言（对象语言）和用于讨论对象语言的语言（元语言）所做的区分。然而，塔尔斯基并未提供关于语言中的谓词如何被世界中的实体所满足的形式化解释。例如，他没有解释“是白色的”或“是天鹅”如何能被天鹅的特定实例所满足。就真理符合论而言，它是一种关于语言中的句子如何能为世界之真值的理论，因此它预设了一种关于这种关系的解释，而这种解释本质上是一种常识性的解释。一个实体满足谓词“是白色的”当且仅当它是白色的，满足谓词“是天鹅的”当且仅当它是天鹅。基于此，塔尔斯基能够对涉及白色和天鹅的概括的真值给出形式化的描述。“所有的天鹅都是白色的”为真当且仅当世界上所有的天鹅确实都是白色的。塔尔斯基并没有阐明语言或理论中的陈述与它们所描述的世界情境之间的对应关系，而是假定了这种对应关系的存在。塔尔斯基形式化方法的任何后续改进和扩展也没有改变这种情况。

I gave a brief account of Tarski’s account of the correspondence theory of truth in chapter 15. Tarski showed that given the notion of the satisfaction of the predicates of a reasonably simple language the truth of propositions in that language can be explicated in a formal way that avoids difficulties typically associated with the notion of truth. As we have seen, his success stemmed from the distinction he made between the language whose truth-claims are being analysed, the object language, and the language being used to talk about the object language, the metalanguage. What Tarski did not supply was a formal account of how predicates in a language are satisfied by entities in the world. He did not give an account, for instance, of how it is that ‘is white’ or ‘is a swan’ can be satisfied by a particular instance of a swan. Insofar as the correspondence theory of truth is a theory of how sentences in a language can be true of the world, it presupposes an account of that relation which is essentially a commonsense account. An entity satisfies the predicate ‘is white’ if and only if it is white and satisfies ‘is a swan’ if it is a swan. Given this, Tarski is able to give a formal account of truth of generalisations involving whiteness and swans. ‘All swans are white’ is true if and only if all swans in the world are indeed white. The notion of correspondence between statements in a language or theory and the situations in the world that they describe is not explicated, but rather assumed, by Tarski. Nor has this situation been changed by any subsequent improvements and extensions of Tarski’s formalisations.

实在论者所运用的真理符合论中涉及的符合性概念，是一个源于常识的非技术性概念。因此，它是一个粗略而简便的概念。如此看待它，我们便能轻易理解，当论断超出相关谓词满足意义的范围，或者当需要更高程度的精确性时，符合性的具体案例是如何失效的。或许，常识告诉我们，从高处垂直下落的物体比沿相同高度的平滑斜面滚动的物体速度更快。但从更精细的角度来看，这需要进行大量的限定。首先，我们需要认识到，“运动”一词并未区分速度和加速度。垂直下落的加速度确实大于沿斜面滚动的加速度。但就速度而言，情况就复杂得多。每种运动的速度都在瞬息万变，因此，如果“运动”指的是速度，那么关于哪个运动更快的问题就定义不清了。如果我们把“运动”解释为平均速度，那么两种运动的速度就相同，因为平均速度相同。从更精细的角度来看，我们可以从粗略的描述中推导出近似的真理。“垂直向下运动速度更快”的说法是正确的，因为它耗时更短。更重要的是，正是现实世界的现象使得这一说法成立。从某种意义上说，涉及速度和加速度的更精细的描述比涉及运动的粗略描述更接近真理，尽管粗略的说法也可以被认为是近似正确的。我们现在知道，如果将精细的概念扩展到极小或极大、极快的领域，它们也需要进一步的完善，最终只能近似地接近真理。

The notion of correspondence involved in the correspondence theory of truth exploited by realists is a non-technical notion having its origins in commonsense. As such it is a rough and ready notion. Treating it as such, we can straightforwardly appreciate how particular cases of correspondence can break down when claims are pushed beyond the realm in which satisfaction of the predicates involved make sense or when greater levels of precision are demanded. Perhaps it makes commonsense to say that an object falling straight down from a height moves faster than one rolling down a smooth inclined plane over the same height. But this needs considerable qualification from a more refined point of view. First, one needs to recognise that ‘moves’ does not distinguish between velocity and acceleration. It is true that the straight down motion has a greater acceleration than the inclined one. When it comes to velocity the situation is more complicated. The velocity of each motion changes from moment to moment, so if ‘motion’ means velocity the question concerning which moves faster is ill defined. If we interpret ‘motion’ as average velocity then one motion is not faster than the other since the average velocity is the same in the two cases. From the more refined point of view approximate truth can be recovered from the unrefined one. The claim that the straight down motion is the faster is true in the sense that it takes less time. What is more, it is happenings in the world that make it true. There is a straightforward sense in which the more refined description involving velocities and accelerations is a better approximation to the truth than the unrefined description involving motion, although there is a sense in which the unrefined claim can be said to be approximately true. We now know that if the refined notions are pushed into the realms of the very small or the very large and very fast they too prove to be in need of further refinement and turn out to be only approximations to the truth.

我一直坚持认为，语言表述的主张与其所描述的世界之间的对应关系源于常识。我们并非先学习日常语言，然后再学习如何将其应用于现实世界。学习如何运用和理解包含“天鹅”一词的句子，并将对天鹅的描述应用于现实世界中天鹅的实例，是同一个过程的不同部分。真理的对应论隐含在我们日常的语言使用中。然而，认识到对应关系源于常识并不意味着它就止步于此。我关于下落速度的例子已经暗示了这一点。虽然我们可以通过日常观察粗略估计下落时间，但速度的估计却无法做到。这是因为速度的估计涉及瞬时速度，而速度会随时间变化。对运动物体速度的主张“与事实相符”程度的估计，需要通过间接测量而非直接观察来进行。然而，正如我上面的讨论所例证的（顺便一提，这讨论是基于伽利略对常识观念的批判以及他自己对更精确观念的阐述），只要更精细的概念是为了解决粗糙概念的问题而产生的，那么某种程度的参照连续性就能得到保证。伽利略构建的新运动概念中蕴含着一种对应关系，根据这种对应关系，说“物体x的速度为v”当且仅当物体x的速度为v，就如同说“天鹅是白色的”当且仅当天鹅是白色的一样，显得理所当然。

I have insisted that the notion of correspondence between linguistically formulated claims and the world they make claims about has its origins in commonsense. We do not first learn our everyday language and then learn how to apply it to the world. Learning how to manipulate and know the meaning of sentences involving ‘swan’ and applying talk of swans to instances of swans in the real world are parts of a single process. A correspondence theory of truth is implicit in our everyday usage of language. However, to recognise that correspondence has its origins in commonsense is not to say that it stays there. My example about speeds of falling is already suggestive of this. While rough estimates of times of fall are accessible to everyday observation, estimates of velocity are not. How could they be since they involve velocity at an instant, because velocity can vary from moment to moment. Estimates of the extent to which claims about the velocity of a moving object ‘correspond to the facts’ involve indirect measurements rather than direct observations. Nevertheless, as is exemplified in my discussion above (which is, incidentally, based on Galileo’s criticism of commonsense notions and his own formulation of more precise ones), some continuity of reference is guaranteed insofar as the more refined notions arise as a response to problems with the crude ones. The new conception of motion fashioned by Galileo had a notion of correspondence built into it according to which it would seem as trite to say that ‘object x has velocity v’ is true if and only if object x has velocity v as to say that ‘the swan is white’ is true if and only if the swan is white.

随着物理学对物质结构的探索不断深入，其概念与常识的偏差越来越大，而检验其论断的经验方法也变得越来越间接。以至于当代物理学所描述的物质深层结构，使得谈论事物拥有属性变得不再恰当。在这个层面上，Ladyman和Ross（2007）坚持认为“一切都必须改变”，这不无道理。但这并不意味着我们否定了与事实相符的概念。我们仍然可以理直气壮地认为，当代物质理论只要与事实相符，就是正确的，无论这些事实与白天鹅或碰撞的台球等事实有多么不同。由于这些抽象理论的出现是为了改进早期理论，因此新理论本身就包含一定程度的与事实的对应关系。它们必须解决先前理论存在的问题，并效仿其成功之处。新理论体系的产生和解释并非两个独立的步骤。假设它们是不必要的，就会使抽象理论与“事实”之间的对应关系变成一个谜。

As physics has probed deeper into the structure of matter, its concepts have departed more and more from commonsense ones and the ways in which its claims are tested empirically have become more and more indirect. So much so that the deep structure of matter as described by contemporary physics renders it inappropriate to talk of things possessing properties. At this level there is something to be said for the insistence of Ladyman and Ross (2007) that ‘every thing must go’. But this need not be seen us undermining the notion of correspondence to the facts. It can still be meaningfully insisted that contemporary matter theory is true insofar as it corresponds to the facts however much the facts involved differ from those involving white swans or colliding billiard balls. Insofar as the abstract theories involved have arisen as an attempt to improve on earlier theories some degree of correspondence is built into the new theories. They are required to solve the problems with and emulate the success of their predecessor. The generation and interpretation of the new theoretical formulism are not separate steps. Assuming that they are unnecessarily makes attempts to achieve correspondence between the abstract theory and ‘the facts’ into a mystery.

现实层次

Levels of reality

我不认同这样一种观点：当人们通过诉诸潜在结构来解释事物，并发现它们并非如人们所想的那样时，就断定它们是不真实的。液体具有黏度。水比油更容易流过管道，是因为水的黏度比油小。液体对球体运动的阻力与液体的黏度以及球体的半径和速度之间存在斯托克斯定律的关系。这些事实可以用分子运动论来解释。它们取决于液体中某一区域的宏观运动如何通过构成液体的分子运动和碰撞的统计结果传递到其他区域。根据分子运动论对黏度的解释，我们可以理解，关于黏度的论断是有局限性的，当液体或气体的密度变得非常小时，这些论断就会失效。事实上，在密度足够低的情况下，气体不再具有黏度，因为产生黏度的统计平均值不再有意义。在我看来，由此得出结论认为只有运动碰撞的分子存在，而不存在具有粘性的流体，这种想法是错误的。雨滴比同样大小的口香糖更容易从桉树上滑落。无论是否有观察者在场，这类现象都会发生，而正是这些现象本身决定了描述它们的陈述是真是假。人们已经承认，在密度足够低的情况下，关于粘性的讨论会失效。但这并不意味着密度足够高的流体就具有可以被正确或错误描述的粘性。当组成人群的个体分散开来时，人群就不再是人群了，但这并不意味着不存在具有密度并可能涌动的群体。

I resist the idea that when entities are explained by appeal to underlying structures and shown to be not quite what they were thought to be, they are thereby shown to be unreal. Liquids have a viscosity. Water flows through pipes more readily than oil does because it possesses a smaller viscosity than oil. The force with which a liquid resists the motion of a sphere through it is related to the viscosity of the liquid and the radius and velocity of the sphere by Stokes’ law. These facts can be explained by the kinetic theory. They depend on the way that macroscopic motions in one region of a liquid are transported to other regions as a statistical result of the motions and collisions of the molecules that constitute the liquid. In the light of the explanation of viscosity by the kinetic theory it can be appreciated that claims about viscosity have their limits and break down when the density of the liquid or gas becomes very small. Indeed, at sufficiently low densities gases cease to have a viscosity because the statistical averages that give rise to it cease to be meaningful. It seems to me to be wrong-headed to conclude from this that only moving, colliding molecules, and not fluids with viscosity, exist. A raindrop runs down a eucalypt more readily than a globule of gum of the same size. Such happenings take place whether there is an observer present to witness them or not, and it is the happenings themselves that make statements describing them true or false. It has been acknowledged that at sufficiently low densities talk of viscosity breaks down. But this does not mean that sufficiently dense fluids have a viscosity that can be truly or falsely characterised. Crowds cease to be crowds when the individuals composing them disperse, but this does not mean that there is no such thing as a crowd which has a density and can surge.2

任何倾向于认为分子运动论表明确实存在运动的分子，但并不表明存在具有粘性的液体和气体的人，很快就会发现自己否认了分子的真实存在。因为分子的性质是通过其电子结构来解释的。分子中的电子类似于大型火车站中的一只苍蝇，因此分子主要由空间构成，与分子运动论所描述的微型台球截然不同。然而，电子本身可能具有某种内部结构，可以解释其性质。认为通过援引更基本的实体来解释实体，实际上就否定了实体本身的观点，会导致终极实在论。根据这种观点，科学的目标是描述现实的终极结构。这种描述将是绝对正确的，它将绝对符合事实。与气体粘性或电子轨迹的讨论不同，后者在超出其极限时会失效，而对终极现实的真实描述将没有这样的限制。

Anyone inclined to the view that the kinetic theory shows that there are really molecules in motion but not really liquids and gases with viscosity will soon find themselves denying that molecules are real. For the properties of molecules are explained by reference to their electronic structure. An electron in a molecule is analogous to a fly in a large railway station, so a molecule is mostly space and nothing like the miniature billiard ball that the kinetic theory treats it as. However, the electron itself may prove to have an inner structure that explains its properties. The view that in explaining entities by invoking more fundamental ones we thereby explain them away leads to ultimate realism. According to this view, the aim of science is to characterise the ultimate structure of reality. Such a characterisation will be true in an unqualified sense. It will correspond to the facts in an unqualified sense. Unlike talk of the viscosity of a gas or the trajectory of an electron, which can break down when pushed beyond its limits, the true description of ultimate reality will have no such limits.

终极实在论会受到严重的质疑。其中之一是认识论上的质疑。我们如何才能确定我们最基本的物理学已经达到了终极阶段？如果物理学史可以作为参考，那么成功的理论最终都会被更深层次的理论所解释。更重要的是，更深层次的理论会引入与它们能够解释的实体截然不同的实体。鉴于此，我们可以预期，未来基础物理学中涉及的现实描述将与当前的基础物理学显著不同。现实的终极描述不仅将超出科学的范畴，而且也不是科学能够合理地接近的终点。

Ultimate realism is open to serious objections. One of them is epistemological. How can we ever know that our most fundamental physics has reached the ultimate stage? If the history of physics is anything to go by, then successful theories get to be explained by deeper ones. What is more, the deeper theories invoke entities very unlike those they are able to explain. Given this, we might expect that the characterisation of reality involved in future fundamental physics will differ markedly from current fundamental physics. The ultimate characterisation of reality will not only be beyond the reach of science but it will also not be an end point which science can be sensibly said to approach.

终极实在论的一个更严重的难题在于我对真理符合论的描述。终极实在论预设了一种与事实完全一致的理论。这其中存在着深刻的问题。我们的理论是人类建构的产物，它们以语言（通常是数学语言）构建而成，而这些语言本身也是人类建构的。如果存在一个终极的实在结构，它就不是人类建构的，因此，描述它的那些完全一致的真理也应该不是人类建构的。一个认为科学朝着终极真理发展的人，必须设想我们人类建构的理论最终会趋向于一个根本不是人类建构的观点。终极实在论者所假定的与事实完全一致的客观概念，暗示着关于世界的陈述与世界本身之间存在着一种符合论无法提供的联系。我们只能拥有粗略的、现成的对应关系，或者说是某种程度上的对应关系。但这种粗略而简便的概念，隐含于常识之中，并经科学完善，是可以理解的，足以解释科学作为探求真理和不断接近真理的过程。如果反实在论等同于声称终极实在论是不连贯的或超出了科学的理解范围，那么我完全赞成反实在论。

A more serious difficulty with ultimate realism is implied by my characterisation of the correspondence theory of truth. Ultimate realism presupposes a theory that corresponds to the facts in an unqualified way. There are deep problems with what this could possibly amount to. Our theories are human constructions framed in languages, often mathematical languages, which are themselves human constructions. If there is an ultimate structure of reality it is not a human construction, so, presumably, the unqualified truths that describe it are not human constructions either. An ultimate realist who thinks that science progresses towards ultimate truth must envisage our humanly constructed theories converging on a view that is not a human construction at all. The notion of unqualified, objective correspondence to the facts assumed by the ultimate realist implies a relationship between statements about the world and the world itself that the correspondence theory of truth is unable to provide. We only have rough and ready correspondence or correspondence up to a point. But this rough and ready notion, implicit in commonsense and refined by science, is intelligible and is sufficient to make sense of science as a search for the truth and as progressing towards the truth. If anti-realism amounts to the claim that ultimate realism is incoherent or beyond the grasp of science then I am all for anti-realism.

延伸阅读

Further reading

Chalmers (2009) 对科学原子论和哲学原子论之间的区别进行了详尽的历史分析。Mayo 和 Spanos (2010) 探讨了与理论证实相关的辩论。Ladyman 和 Ross (2007) 对结构实在论进行了最新的阐述和辩护。van Fraassen (2009) 和 Chalmers (2011) 的交流详细分析了 Perrin 关于布朗运动实验的地位和意义。Nye (1972) 提供了有用的历史背景。

The distinction between scientific and philosophical atomism is analysed in historical detail in Chalmers (2009). Relevant debates concerning theory-confirmation are in Mayo and Spanos (2010). A recent articulation and defence of structural realism is in Ladyman and Ross (2007). Detailed analyses of the status and significance of Perrin’s experiments on Brownian motion are in the interchange between van Fraassen (2009) and Chalmers (2011). Useful historical background can be found in Nye (1972).

1. Since first writing The Structure of Scientific Revolutions Kuhn has conceded that he originally used ‘paradigm’ in a number of different ways. In the Postscript accompanying the second edition he distinguishes two senses of the word, a general sense which he calls the ‘disciplinary matrix’, and a narrow sense of the term which he has replaced by ‘exemplar’. I continue to use the word ‘paradigm’ in the general sense, to refer to what Kuhn now calls the disciplinary matrix.

11. Methodical changes in method

1. 本段的论述并非暗示科学在社会中的运作方式不容许进行政治和社会分析，正如我在《科学及其建构》（1990年，第八章）中试图阐明的那样。我的论述也并非意在否定所有被称为“科学社会研究”的成果，因为许多当代研究已经对科学工作的本质提供了有效的见解。我的论述仅针对那些自认为已经构建了地位崇高的社会学或其他知识体系，并以此为标准来评判科学知识不具备任何特殊地位的人。

1. My remarks in this paragraph should not be taken as implying that there is no room for a political and social analysis of science as it functions in society, as I try to make clear in Science and Its Fabrication (1990, chapter 8). Nor are my remarks intended to be dismissive of all that goes under the name of ‘social studies of science’ since much contemporary work has yielded valid insights into the nature of scientific work. They are directed only at those who consider themselves to have constructed sociological or other knowledge of such a high status that from its point of view they can judge that scientific knowledge has no special status.

17. 后记

17. Postscript

1. 在超显微镜下，观察标本是通过观察垂直于观察方向散射的光来实现的。在佩兰的实验中，悬浮液分子在该方向上散射的光与布朗粒子散射的光相比可以忽略不计，因此消除了前者产生的眩光。

1. In the ultra microscope a specimen is observed by viewing the light scattered at right angles to the direction in which it is observed. In Perrin’s experiments the light scattered by the molecules of the suspending fluid in that direction was negligible compared with that scattered by the Brownian particles, so the glare from the former was eliminated.

2. 我同意艾伦·马斯格雷夫（1999，第132-133页）的观点，他赞同苏珊·斯蒂宾（1937）对爱丁顿两张表格（常识表格和分子表格）的处理方式。正如马斯格雷夫所说，当科学从分子相互作用的角度解释表格的坚固性时，“它并没有表明表格不像常识所认为的那样坚固”。

2. I agree with Alan Musgrave (1999, pp. 132–3) when he endorses the treatment of Eddington’s two tables, the commonsense one and the molecular one, by Susan Stebbing (1937). As Musgrave says, when science explains the solidity of the table in terms of molecular interactions ‘it does not show that the table is not solid as commonsense supposes’.
